title: The rapidly growing burden of dengue fever in China from 2005 to 2024: spatiotemporal patterns and age-sex-specific disparities in incidence and disability-adjusted life years.
abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever has transitioned from a sporadic imported infection to an established domestic threat in China, challenging the conventional view of its non-endemic status. Understanding its evolving epidemiological landscape over the past two decades is critical for evidence-based intervention planning. Methods We analyzed national notifiable dengue surveillance data from 2005 to 2024. Temporal trends were assessed using Joinpoint regression to estimate average annual percent changes (AAPC) in incidence, stratified by age, sex, and province, with particular focus on Guangdong and Yunnan. Spatial heterogeneity was characterized through standardized provincial incidence mapping. Disease burden was quantified using disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), incorporating years of life lost and years lived with disability, based on locally derived severity distributions and disability weights. Results A total of 138,885 cases and 14 deaths were reported. Annual case counts rose sharply from 40 to 24,278, with major epidemic peaks in 2014, 2019, 2023, and 2024. The age-standardized incidence increased significantly (AAPC: + 30.1%). Adults aged 25–49 years constituted 49.2% of all cases, yet the steepest relative increases occurred among children aged 0–9 years (male AAPC + 32.7%, female + 35.4%) and adults aged ≥ 70 years (male + 43.3%, female + 39.6%). High-risk category I regions accounted for 87.1% of the national burden, though other low-risk regions exhibited accelerating incidence among specific adult male subgroups. Total DALYs reached 2206.9 person-years (age-standardized rate: 0.0744 per million), predominantly driven by YLD and concentrated in the working-age population (79.5%). Conclusions Dengue in China has entered a phase of rapid burden escalation with widening demographic and geographic reach. While the working-age population bears the largest absolute burden, children and older adults face the fastest-rising risk. These findings underscore the urgency of transitioning from reactive outbreak response to precision public health, integrating age-targeted interventions, regionally stratified surveillance, and serological monitoring within a One Health framework to inform future vaccine deployment.

title_zh: 2005年至2024年中国登革热负担的快速增长:发病率和伤残调整生命年的时空模式和年龄性别差异。
source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengue fever has transitioned from a sporadic imported infection to an established domestic threat in China, challenging the conventional view of its non-endemic status. Understanding its evolving epidemiological landscape over the past two decades is critical for evidence-based intervention planning. Methods We analyzed national notifiable dengue surveillance data from 2005 to 2024. Temporal trends were assessed using Joinpoint regression to estimate average annual percent changes (AAPC) in incidence, stratified by age, sex, and province, with particular focus on Guangdong and Yunnan. Spatial heterogeneity was characterized through standardized provincial incidence mapping. Disease burden was quantified using disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), incorporating years of life lost and years lived with disability, based on locally derived severity distributions and disability weights. Results A total of 138,885 cases and 14 deaths were reported. Annual case counts rose sharply from 40 to 24,278, with major epidemic peaks in 2014, 2019, 2023, and 2024. The age-standardized incidence increased significantly (AAPC: + 30.1%). Adults aged 25–49 years constituted 49.2% of all cases, yet the steepest relative increases occurred among children aged 0–9 years (male AAPC + 32.7%, female + 35.4%) and adults aged ≥ 70 years (male + 43.3%, female + 39.6%). High-risk category I regions accounted for 87.1% of the national burden, though other low-risk regions exhibited accelerating incidence among specific adult male subgroups. Total DALYs reached 2206.9 person-years (age-standardized rate: 0.0744 per million), predominantly driven by YLD and concentrated in the working-age population (79.5%). Conclusions Dengue in China has entered a phase of rapid burden escalation with widening demographic and geographic reach. While the working-age population bears the largest absolute burden, children and older adults face the fastest-rising risk. These findings underscore the urgency of transitioning from reactive outbreak response to precision public health, integrating age-targeted interventions, regionally stratified surveillance, and serological monitoring within a One Health framework to inform future vaccine deployment.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热 已从散发性输入性感染转变为中国境内已确定的威胁,挑战了其非流行状态的传统观点。了解过去二十年不断变化的流行病学格局对于循证干预规划至关重要。方法 我们分析了 2005 年至 2024 年全国应通报的登革热 监测 数据。使用 Joinpoint 回归评估时间趋势,以估计 监测 的平均年百分比变化 (AAPC),按年龄、性别和省份分层,特别关注广东和云南。通过标准化的省级 发病率 制图来表征空间异质性。根据当地得出的严重程度分布和残疾权重,使用残疾调整生命年(DALY)来量化疾病负担,其中包括生命损失年数和残疾生存年数。结果 累计报告病例138885例,死亡14例。年度病例数从 40 例急剧上升至 24,278 例,主要流行高峰出现在 2014 年、2019 年、2023 年和 2024 年。年龄标准化的 发病率 显着增加(AAPC:+ 30.1%)。25-49岁成年人占所有病例的49.2%,但相对增幅最大的是0-9岁儿童(男性AAPC + 32.7%,女性+ 35.4%)和70岁以上成年人(男性+ 43.3%,女性+ 39.6%)。高风险 I 类地区占全国负担的 87.1%,尽管其他低风险地区在特定成年男性亚群中表现出加速的 发病率。DALY 总数达到 2206.9 人年(年龄标准化率:0.0744/百万),主要由 YLD 驱动,集中在工作年龄人口(79.5%)。结论 随着人口和地理范围的扩大,中国的登革热已进入负担快速升级的阶段。虽然工作年龄人口承受着最大的绝对负担,但儿童和老年人面临着上升最快的风险。这些发现强调了从反应性 暴发 响应过渡到精准公共卫生的紧迫性,整合针对年龄的干预措施、区域分层的 监测 以及 One Health 框架内的血清学监测,为未来的 疫苗 部署提供信息。

title: CD8+ T cells and humoral immunity may mitigate the effects of antibody-dependent enhancement: implications for dengue vaccine design.
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue vaccine development is complicated by antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)—a phenomenon in which antibodies paradoxically boost viral growth. Signals of immune-mediated enhancement were observed in the CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine trials, but have not yet been reported for trials of TAK-003 (Qdenga). To better understand how prior immunity influences dengue infection outcomes, we developed a mechanistic within-host model of acute dengue infection dynamics that incorporates ADE as well as humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. Model simulations illustrate a potentially very important difference between enhancement by antibody, enhancement by humoral immunity, and enhanced severity of secondary infection. Model results also suggest that recipients of CYD-TDV may have been more likely to experience immune-mediated enhancement because of its yellow fever virus backbone and corresponding lack of dengue-specific CD8+ T-cell epitopes. The model provides a possible explanation for differences in reported outcomes of dengue vaccine trials and suggests incorporating DENV backbones from all four serotypes as a potentially promising way forward in the design of future dengue vaccines. IMPORTANCE Vaccines are typically designed to elicit humoral (antibody-mediated) immunity, and antibody titers are commonly used as correlates of protection. Because CD8+ T-cell responses are more challenging to measure, they are not typically used as correlates of protection and have received comparatively less attention. For viruses such as dengue, where antibodies may increase viral replication and thus the risk of severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement, it is necessary to understand how humoral and cellular immunity interact during infection. Our model suggests that low antibody levels can enhance viral replication but that this effect can be mitigated by humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. This result offers a hypothesis to explain the observed differences in outcomes between the CYD-TDV and TAK-003 trials and suggests that evaluating CD8+ T-cell responses alongside antibody titers may be important for designing and assessing the safety and efficacy of future dengue vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how prior immunity influences dengue infection outcomes, focusing on the interplay between humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. The research highlights the challenges posed by antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) in dengue vaccine development, particularly with the CYD-TDV vaccine. The authors developed a mechanistic within-host model to simulate dengue infection dynamics, incorporating ADE and immune responses. Their findings suggest that the CYD-TDV vaccine's yellow fever virus backbone may contribute to immune-mediated enhancement due to the lack of dengue-specific CD8+ T-cell epitopes. The model offers an explanation for differences in outcomes between CYD-TDV and TAK-003 trials and proposes that using DENV backbones from all four serotypes could improve future vaccine design. The study emphasizes the importance of evaluating both antibody titers and CD8+ T-cell responses for vaccine safety and efficacy. However, the evidence does not explicitly report limitations or evidence strength.

title_zh: CD8+ T 细胞和体液免疫可能会减轻 抗体依赖性增强 的影响:对登革热 疫苗 设计的影响。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue vaccine development is complicated by antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)—a phenomenon in which antibodies paradoxically boost viral growth. Signals of immune-mediated enhancement were observed in the CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine trials, but have not yet been reported for trials of TAK-003 (Qdenga). To better understand how prior immunity influences dengue infection outcomes, we developed a mechanistic within-host model of acute dengue infection dynamics that incorporates ADE as well as humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. Model simulations illustrate a potentially very important difference between enhancement by antibody, enhancement by humoral immunity, and enhanced severity of secondary infection. Model results also suggest that recipients of CYD-TDV may have been more likely to experience immune-mediated enhancement because of its yellow fever virus backbone and corresponding lack of dengue-specific CD8+ T-cell epitopes. The model provides a possible explanation for differences in reported outcomes of dengue vaccine trials and suggests incorporating DENV backbones from all four serotypes as a potentially promising way forward in the design of future dengue vaccines. IMPORTANCE Vaccines are typically designed to elicit humoral (antibody-mediated) immunity, and antibody titers are commonly used as correlates of protection. Because CD8+ T-cell responses are more challenging to measure, they are not typically used as correlates of protection and have received comparatively less attention. For viruses such as dengue, where antibodies may increase viral replication and thus the risk of severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement, it is necessary to understand how humoral and cellular immunity interact during infection. Our model suggests that low antibody levels can enhance viral replication but that this effect can be mitigated by humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. This result offers a hypothesis to explain the observed differences in outcomes between the CYD-TDV and TAK-003 trials and suggests that evaluating CD8+ T-cell responses alongside antibody titers may be important for designing and assessing the safety and efficacy of future dengue vaccines.
abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热 疫苗 的发展因 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 而变得复杂化,在这种现象中,抗体反而促进了病毒生长。在 CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) 疫苗 试验中观察到免疫介导的增强信号,但尚未在 TAK-003 (Qdenga) 试验中报告。为了更好地了解先前的免疫如何影响登革热感染结果,我们开发了一种急性登革热感染动态的 宿主 内机械模型,该模型结合了 ADE 以及体液和 CD8+ T 细胞免疫。模型模拟说明了抗体增强、体液免疫增强和继发感染严重程度增强之间潜在的非常重要的差异。模型结果还表明,CYD-TDV 的接受者可能更有可能经历免疫介导的增强,因为其黄热病病毒骨架以及相应的登革热特异性 CD8+ T 细胞表位的缺乏。该模型为登革热 疫苗 试验报告结果的差异提供了可能的解释,并建议将所有四种血清型的 DENV 主链纳入未来登革热 疫苗 设计中的潜在有前途的方法。重要性 疫苗 通常设计用于引发体液(抗体介导的)免疫,抗体滴度通常用作保护的相关性。由于 CD8+ T 细胞反应更难以测量,因此它们通常不用作保护的相关因素,并且受到的关注相对较少。对于登革热等病毒,抗体可能会增加病毒复制,从而通过 抗体依赖性增强 增加患严重疾病的风险,有必要了解感染期间体液免疫和细胞免疫如何相互作用。我们的模型表明,低抗体水平可以增强病毒复制,但这种效应可以通过体液免疫和 CD8+ T 细胞免疫来减轻。这一结果提供了一个假设来解释 CYD-TDV 和 TAK-003 试验之间观察到的结果差异,并表明评估 CD8+ T 细胞反应以及抗体滴度对于设计和评估未来登革热 疫苗 的安全性和有效性可能很重要。

title: Comprehensive profiling of genotype-specific dengue antibody responses using a newly developed single-round infectious particle panel.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Neutralizing antibodies provide critical protection against dengue virus (DENV) infections. However, under certain conditions, antibodies can also enhance infection and contribute to severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). ADE can occur through extrinsic mechanisms, in which antibody-opsonized virions engage with Fcγ receptors (FcγRs) on target cells to facilitate increased viral entry, while intrinsic mechanisms have been proposed in which FcγR-mediated uptake triggers intracellular pathways that promote viral replication. The extensive genetic diversity of DENV further complicates the evaluation of antibody functionality, as antibodies may exhibit distinct neutralizing and enhancing activities against different viral genotypes. Here, we developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes across all four DENV serotypes. This genotype-inclusive platform enables assessment of antibody-mediated neutralization and FcγR-dependent enhancement of infection through luciferase reporter quantification. Using this panel, we evaluated antibody responses from DENV-infected individuals, healthy volunteers, and flavivirus-cross-reactive or DENV-specific monoclonal antibodies. Our findings reveal genotype-specific variations in antibody-mediated neutralization and enhancement, emphasizing the complex interplay between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. This SRIP panel provides a robust approach for profiling functional antibodies against genetically diverse DENV strains. While the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and intracellular replicon-based readout provide a foundation for future investigations of intrinsic ADE mechanisms. Overall, this platform offers broad applications for studying dengue immunity, evaluating vaccine-induced antibody responses, and advancing our understanding of antibody-mediated protection and disease enhancement. IMPORTANCE: Dengue virus (DENV) comprises four serotypes and substantial genetic diversity, which can influence the ability of antibodies to neutralize or enhance infection. However, comparative assessment of antibody functionality across diverse DENV genotypes remains challenging because differences in viral genetic backgrounds can confound functional measurements. We developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes in which the prM and E structural proteins are varied on a common replicon backbone. This design provides a standardized platform for directly comparing antibody-mediated neutralization and Fcγ receptor-dependent enhancement across genetically diverse DENV strains. By characterizing antibody responses against a broad range of genotypes, the panel can reveal differences in functional antibody activity that may be overlooked when using a limited number of representative strains. The platform is therefore useful for investigating how DENV genetic diversity influences antibody-mediated protection and extrinsic antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), as well as for evaluating the breadth of antibody responses induced by infection or vaccination. Although the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and quantitative intracellular reporter readout provide a foundation for future studies investigating intrinsic ADE in more physiologically relevant immune cell models. This genotype-inclusive panel offers a practical approach for standardized functional profiling of dengue antibodies and may facilitate improved evaluation of vaccine-induced immunity and antibody responses across the genetic diversity of DENV.

title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication.
abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore splicing changes associated with dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment, as alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism altered during viral infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in cultured cells, comparing splicing changes induced by DENV infection with those caused by IFN treatment, which serves as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation.
analysis.methods: The researchers used CRISPR/dCas9 tools to modulate CLK1 expression and pharmacological inhibitors to block CLK1 kinase activity, assessing the impact on immune response gene induction and DENV replication.
analysis.main_results: Silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated this effect. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that CLK1 acts as a negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, and its inhibition could potentially enhance antiviral defenses against dengue virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight CLK1 as a potential therapeutic target for enhancing antiviral defenses and improving treatment strategies for dengue virus infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cultured cells, and the evidence is based on modulating CLK1 expression and activity, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of CLK1 in modulating the innate immune response and dengue virus replication. It identifies CLK1 as a negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, with its inhibition enhancing antiviral defenses. The research was conducted in cultured cells, using CRISPR/dCas9 and pharmacological inhibitors to manipulate CLK1 expression and activity. Results show that CLK1 silencing boosts immune response gene induction, while its overexpression dampens this effect. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further enhances IFN-induced gene expression and reduces DENV replication. These findings suggest CLK1 as a potential therapeutic target for dengue virus treatment. However, the study is limited to in vitro models, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the experimental nature of the approach.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore splicing changes associated with dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment, as alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism altered during viral infection.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in cultured cells, comparing splicing changes induced by DENV infection with those caused by IFN treatment, which serves as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers used CRISPR/dCas9 tools to modulate CLK1 expression and pharmacological inhibitors to block CLK1 kinase activity, assessing the impact on immune response gene induction and DENV replication.
analysis_en.main_results: Silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated this effect. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that CLK1 acts as a negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression, and its inhibition could potentially enhance antiviral defenses against dengue virus.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results highlight CLK1 as a potential therapeutic target for enhancing antiviral defenses and improving treatment strategies for dengue virus infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to cultured cells, and the evidence is based on modulating CLK1 expression and activity, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate.

title_zh: 通过 CRISPR 工具和药理抑制来靶向 CLK1 可调节先天的 免疫应答 和 登革病毒 复制。
source_body_en: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 选择性剪接是已知在病毒感染时发生改变的关键调节机制。这些改变可能来自病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能来自细胞反应,例如先天免疫的激活。在这里,我们研究了培养细胞中 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染和干扰素 (IFN) 治疗 之间共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒依赖性先天免疫激活的模型。在常见事件中,我们发现 CLK1 基因非编码 mRNA 亚型的产量增加,从而产生一种磷酸化剪接因子(包括 SR 蛋白和剪接体成分)的激酶。与这一发现一致,IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平降低。使用具有 CRISPR/dCas9 介导的 CLK1 表达调节的稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过度表达则减弱了这种诱导。用药理学抑制剂 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性,进一步增强 IFN 诱导的基因表达并减少 DENV 复制。总而言之,这些结果确定 CLK1 是 IFN 刺激的基因表达的前病毒负调节因子,并表明其抑制可以增强 抗病毒药物 防御并成为治疗策略的目标。

title: Trends and Patterns of Dengue Incidence and Mortality in Bangladesh: A Re-Emerging Public Health Issue.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Bangladesh faced a rapid dengue outbreak in its history after the year 2020 which marked as a re‐emerging health issue. This study aims to assess the significant change of the trends and patterns of dengue incidence and mortality over the year from 2000 to 2025 in Bangladesh. Methods The publicly available government data were used from the Management Information System of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Bangladesh, from 2000 to 2025. The data were cleaned, coded, and a descriptive analysis was performed using the Microsoft Excel. For assessing the significant trend of dengue cases, deaths, and case fatality rate (CFR), the Mann–Kendall test and Sen's slope estimator were conducted using the RStudio version 4.6.0 software. Moreover, Joinpoint regression software was used to analyze the temporal trends of dengue cases and deaths with p value less than 0.05 considered statistically significant. Results According to the findings, the highest dengue record cases and deaths were reported in 2023 where 321,179 cases and 1705 deaths occurred as highest in the history of Bangladesh. Females and the elderly were most vulnerable in 2023 and other years as well. The CFR was high among the older population aged 61+, as highest in 2024. Most of the dengue cases and deaths occurred from July to December. The dengue cases and deaths significantly increased over the year from 2000 to 2025. But the CFR was not statistically significant over the year. Conclusion Dengue significantly increased over the year and has become more fatal since 2020. More effective strategies are needed to prevent and control the exposure of cases and deaths of dengue. The policy suggests to enhancing the awareness programs for preventing dengue exposure and strengthening the health system capacity for government.

elements_zh.main_results: 调查结果显示,2023 年报告了登革热病例和死亡人数最高记录,其中 321,179 例病例和 1705 人死亡,为孟加拉国历史最高记录。2000年至2025年,登革热病例和死亡人数显着增加。病死率逐年没有统计显着性。

title: A bispecific mRNA vaccine against zika and dengue viruses to overcome antibody-dependent enhancement and provide protection in preclinical models.
abstract: Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus (DENV) are two widespread flaviviruses that pose a significant threat to public health. Owing to their extensive co-circulation and antigenic cross-reactivity, both viruses carry the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), a phenomenon that renders existing vaccines unable to simultaneously protect against both pathogens. To overcome this limitation, we developed a bispecific mRNA vaccine against ZIKV and DENV (bis-mZDV) by integrating orthogonal B-cell and T-cell modules. The B-cell module was constructed by fusing ZIKV EDIII to the self-adjuvanting complement component C3d to enhance neutralizing antibody titers. The T-cell module incorporated conserved epitopes from ZIKV and DENV, thereby inducing cross-reactive CD8+ T cells without eliciting ADE-prone B-cell responses. Notably, the new bis-mZDV achieved up to an 8-fold enhancement in neutralizing antibody titers compared to the unadjuvanted EDIII mRNA vaccine. More importantly, in immunodeficient mice, it conferred protection against both ZIKV and DENV challenges and elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses. The bis-mZDV represents a promising strategy that may be applicable to co-circulating pathogens and other viruses associated with ADE.

title: Variation among dengue virus-1 lineages affects the neutralization breadth of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination
abstract: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) genetic diversity within serotypes may influence the breadth and durability of vaccine-induced immunity. We developed a panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles encompassing ~ 74% of known global envelope protein diversity and evaluated neutralization using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. Neutralization varied substantially among DENV-1 lineages and differed by exposure history. Several variants showed reduced neutralization following vaccination despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time. Natural infection produced comparatively uniform neutralization across the panel. We used antigenic cartography to identify specific envelope amino acid positions associated with increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. These findings demonstrate substantial within-serotype antigenic variation and support using diverse lineages to assess DENV vaccine-induced immunity.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate how genetic variation within dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) lineages influences the breadth and durability of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination. The background highlights that DENV genetic diversity may impact vaccine-induced immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated neutralization responses using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. A panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles was developed to encompass ~74% of known global envelope protein diversity.
analysis.methods: Antigenic cartography was employed to identify specific envelope amino acid positions linked to increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. Neutralization was assessed by evaluating responses to the DENV-1 panel.
analysis.main_results: Several DENV-1 variants exhibited reduced neutralization following vaccination, despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate significant within-serotype antigenic variation and suggest that diverse DENV-1 lineages should be used to evaluate vaccine-induced immunity. This highlights the importance of lineage diversity in assessing immune responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results have implications for improving the design of DENV vaccines and understanding the effectiveness of immune responses against different viral lineages. They also support the need for broader antigenic coverage in vaccine development.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on sera from specific populations and the use of reporter virus particles. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on observed neutralization patterns without direct causal evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how genetic variation within dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) lineages affects the breadth and durability of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination. A panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles was used to assess neutralization across sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental challenge participants, and individuals with natural infection. Results showed that certain DENV-1 variants had reduced neutralization following vaccination, despite high antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated for 180 days, whereas unvaccinated individuals showed lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time. The findings highlight substantial within-serotype antigenic variation and suggest that diverse DENV-1 lineages should be used to evaluate vaccine-induced immunity. These results have implications for vaccine design and understanding immune responses against different viral lineages. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on specific populations and the use of reporter virus particles without direct causal evidence.

title_zh: 登革病毒-1谱系之间的变异影响感染和疫苗接种引起的抗体反应的中和广度
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) genetic diversity within serotypes may influence the breadth and durability of vaccine-induced immunity. We developed a panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles encompassing ~ 74% of known global envelope protein diversity and evaluated neutralization using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. Neutralization varied substantially among DENV-1 lineages and differed by exposure history. Several variants showed reduced neutralization following vaccination despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time. Natural infection produced comparatively uniform neutralization across the panel. We used antigenic cartography to identify specific envelope amino acid positions associated with increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. These findings demonstrate substantial within-serotype antigenic variation and support using diverse lineages to assess DENV vaccine-induced immunity.

title: Assessment of the knowledge, attitude, and practices of the people on dengue fever and malaria in the central Nepal
abstract: Dengue and malaria remain critical, resurgent public health challenges in Nepal. This study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding these mosquito-borne diseases among 130 households in Hetauda Sub-Metropolitan City, Makawanpur. Utilizing a questionnaire-based survey, the study found that 28% of respondents self-reported a household history of dengue within the past year often cluster-infecting multiple family members while only 1% self-reported history of malaria. Participants demonstrated high knowledge regarding dengue vectors (87%) and prevention (72%), alongside strong confidence (97%) in their chosen treatment strategies. Conversely, knowledge regarding malaria transmission was remarkably low (13%). While community attitudes and knowledge favor dengue prevention, critical gaps persist regarding malaria. These findings underscore the need for targeted, community-level educational interventions and intensified vector control programs to mitigate transmission risks and strengthen regional public health resilience.

title_zh: 评估尼泊尔中部人民对 登革热 和疟疾的知识、态度和做法
source_body_en: Dengue and malaria remain critical, resurgent public health challenges in Nepal. This study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding these mosquito-borne diseases among 130 households in Hetauda Sub-Metropolitan City, Makawanpur. Utilizing a questionnaire-based survey, the study found that 28% of respondents self-reported a household history of dengue within the past year often cluster-infecting multiple family members while only 1% self-reported history of malaria. Participants demonstrated high knowledge regarding dengue vectors (87%) and prevention (72%), alongside strong confidence (97%) in their chosen treatment strategies. Conversely, knowledge regarding malaria transmission was remarkably low (13%). While community attitudes and knowledge favor dengue prevention, critical gaps persist regarding malaria. These findings underscore the need for targeted, community-level educational interventions and intensified vector control programs to mitigate transmission risks and strengthen regional public health resilience.

title: Serum ferritin kinetics and ferritin-derived ratios in hospitalised adults with dengue: A prospective serial biomarker study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue causes major morbidity and mortality across India, where early identification of patients progressing to dengue shock syndrome or severe hepatitis remains an unmet need. Serum ferritin reflects macrophage activation, but its serial kinetics and ferritin-derived composite indices have not been rigorously evaluated in adult Indian populations. We characterised serial ferritin kinetics and evaluated two ferritin-derived ratios: the Ferritin-to-Platelet Ratio (FPR) and the Ferritin/ALT Ratio (FLR). METHODOLOGY: This prospective observational study enrolled 100 adult WHO 2009-confirmed dengue patients at SMIMER, Surat (June 2020-November 2021). Serum ferritin was measured by sandwich ELISA on hospital Days 1, 3 and 5 and was also analysed by day of illness; platelet count and transaminases were the lowest and highest values recorded during the stay, and outcomes were recorded if present at any time between admission and discharge. Severity was classified as non-severe (n = 68) or severe (n = 32). Non-circular endpoints-shock/DSS (n = 22), severe thrombocytopenia <20,000/μL (n = 28), and severe hepatitis AST/ALT ≥ 1,000 IU/L (n = 18)-were the primary outcomes for diagnostic accuracy. FPR and FLR were pre-specified composite indices and were compared with their component tests by paired DeLong tests. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Ferritin showed a rise-peak-fall trajectory across hospital days, peaking on Day 3 (mean 955 ± 177 ng/ml; Friedman p < 10-16); by day of illness it rose from a median of 700 ng/ml (illness days ≤3) to 950 ng/ml (days 6-7) and then plateaued. FPR Day 1 separated the severity groups with AUC 0.704 (95% CI 0.579-0.830); severe patients showed five-fold higher median FPR than non-severe patients (39.0 vs 7.5; p = 0.001). Against shock/DSS, FPR Day 1 had AUC 0.801 (95% CI 0.688-0.898), no higher than platelet count alone (AUC 0.784; DeLong p = 0.41). FLR Day 1 discriminated severe hepatitis with AUC 0.995 (95% CI 0.988-1.000), no higher than ALT alone (AUC 1.000; DeLong p = 0.23), the variable that defines this outcome. Against non-circular outcomes, Ferritin Day 1 discriminated shock/DSS with AUC 0.789 and severe thrombocytopenia with AUC 0.727. The ferritin-platelet inverse correlation was demographic-independent (partial Spearman rho=-0.392; p < 0.001). Ferritin offered no incremental benefit over platelet count alone (NRI = 0.143; IDI = 0.000). CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Serum ferritin rose from admission to hospital Day 3 and was higher in patients with shock and severe thrombocytopenia. The Ferritin-to-Platelet Ratio and the Ferritin/ALT Ratio are low-cost, but neither discriminated better than the routine test it contains (platelet count or ALT). Because platelet count and transaminases entered the ratios as the lowest and highest values of the admission, and outcomes were recorded over the whole stay, both ratios are markers of disease severity rather than predictors of later shock or severe hepatitis. Prospective multi-centre studies with laboratory values and outcomes timed from admission are needed to test any predictive role.

analysis_zh.methods: 在医院第 1、3 和 5 天通过夹心 ELISA 测量血清铁蛋白,并按患病日期进行分析;血小板计数和转氨酶是住院期间记录的最低和最高值,如果在入院和出院之间的任何时间出现,则记录结果。铁蛋白与血小板比率和铁蛋白/ALT 比率成本较低,但两者的区分效果都比其包含的常规测试(血小板计数或 ALT)更好。
analysis_zh.main_results: FPR 第 1 天将严重程度组分开,AUC 0.704 (95% CI 0.579-0.830);重症患者的中位 FPR 是非重症患者的五倍(39.0 vs 7.5;p = 0.001)。针对休克/DSS,FPR 第 1 天的 AUC 为 0.789,严重血小板减少症的 AUC 为 0.727。FLR 第 1 天区分严重肝炎的 AUC 为 0.995(95% CI 0.988-1.000),不高于单独的 ALT(AUC 1.000;DeLong p = 0.23)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 血清铁蛋白从入院第3天开始上升,休克和严重血小板减少症患者的血清铁蛋白更高。铁蛋白-血小板负相关与人口统计无关(部分 Spearman rho=-0.392;p < 0.001)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,血清铁蛋白可能是监测住院登革热成人疾病严重程度的有用生物标志物。然而,这些比率并没有比现有的常规测试有显着改善。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其观察设计和缺乏比率预测价值而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为该研究提供了描述性发现,但没有建立因果关系或预测效用。

title: Toward More Reliable Dengue Early Warning: Bridging the Gap Between Theory and Practice.
abstract: Dengue continues to expand globally, increasing pressure on health systems across tropical and subtropical regions. Despite advances in surveillance, data availability, and predictive modeling, early warning often remains insufficiently linked to timely public health action. The challenge, therefore, is not prediction alone but translating heterogeneous surveillance information into actionable intelligence. Key determinants, including climate, human mobility, adult female mosquito abundance, vector infection, asymptomatic infection, and population immunity, vary in feasibility, spatial and temporal resolution, and early-warning value. Climate indicators provide important context but may lack local specificity, and symptomatic case surveillance is constrained by underascertainment and reporting delays. Human mobility can improve spatial risk assessment and, in selected settings, forecasting, whereas adult mosquito surveillance provides complementary information on local vector abundance. The authors of the present study propose an Operationally Prioritized Early Warning (OPEW) framework that integrates sentinel surveillance, scale-aware interpretation of complementary signals, feasibility-based prioritization, event-triggered intensification, and explicit links between surveillance thresholds and predefined actions. The OPEW framework is not a validated prediction model but a testable operational framework that prioritizes information according to epidemiological relevance, timeliness, feasibility, and decision value. Prospective evaluation should assess predictive performance, actionable lead time, resource requirements, and public health outcomes against existing approaches.
journal: The American journal of tropical medicine and hygiene

title_zh: 实现更可靠的登革热早期预警:弥合理论与实践之间的差距。
source_body_en: Dengue continues to expand globally, increasing pressure on health systems across tropical and subtropical regions. Despite advances in surveillance, data availability, and predictive modeling, early warning often remains insufficiently linked to timely public health action. The challenge, therefore, is not prediction alone but translating heterogeneous surveillance information into actionable intelligence. Key determinants, including climate, human mobility, adult female mosquito abundance, vector infection, asymptomatic infection, and population immunity, vary in feasibility, spatial and temporal resolution, and early-warning value. Climate indicators provide important context but may lack local specificity, and symptomatic case surveillance is constrained by underascertainment and reporting delays. Human mobility can improve spatial risk assessment and, in selected settings, forecasting, whereas adult mosquito surveillance provides complementary information on local vector abundance. The authors of the present study propose an Operationally Prioritized Early Warning (OPEW) framework that integrates sentinel surveillance, scale-aware interpretation of complementary signals, feasibility-based prioritization, event-triggered intensification, and explicit links between surveillance thresholds and predefined actions. The OPEW framework is not a validated prediction model but a testable operational framework that prioritizes information according to epidemiological relevance, timeliness, feasibility, and decision value. Prospective evaluation should assess predictive performance, actionable lead time, resource requirements, and public health outcomes against existing approaches.
abstract_zh: 登革热继续在全球蔓延,给热带和亚热带地区的卫生系统带来越来越大的压力。尽管在 监测、数据可用性和预测模型方面取得了进步,但早期预警往往与及时的公共卫生行动联系不够。因此,挑战不仅仅是预测,而是将异构的 监测 信息转化为可操作的情报。关键决定因素,包括气候、人口流动性、成年雌性蚊子丰度、媒介 感染、无症状感染和群体免疫力,在可行性、时空分辨率和预警价值方面各不相同。气候指标提供了重要的背景信息,但可能缺乏当地的特异性,并且有症状的病例 监测 受到确定不足和报告延迟的限制。人类流动性可以改善空间风险评估,并在选定的环境中进行预测,而成年蚊子 监测 则提供有关当地 媒介 丰度的补充信息。本研究的作者提出了一种操作优先级预警(OPEW)框架,该框架集成了哨兵 监测、互补信号的尺度感知解释、基于可行性的优先级、事件触发的强化以及 监测 阈值和预定义操作之间的显式链接。OPEW 框架不是一个经过验证的预测模型,而是一个可测试的操作框架,它根据流行病学相关性、及时性、可行性和决策价值对信息进行优先级排序。前瞻性评估应根据现有方法评估预测性能、可操作的交付时间、资源需求和公共卫生结果。

title: Spatio-temporal clustering of dengue in Valle del Cauca, Colombia.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is endemic in Colombia's Valle del Cauca region. The precise timing and spatial scale of seasonal dengue transmission necessary for effective reactive interventions at the sub-municipal level across the 42 municipalities of Valle del Cauca remain unclear. This study aimed to identify spatio-temporal dengue clusters in Valle del Cauca. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A retrospective observational study was conducted using individual laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, including residential geolocation and consultation dates, reported by healthcare providers to the Sistema Nacional de Vigilancia en Salud Pública (SIVIGILA) in 2022. Residence was utilized as the probable site of infection. Spatio-temporal clustering was analyzed using Kulldorff's space-time scan statistic to identify statistically significant dengue clusters. Results were mapped using R. As a second aim, the association between clinical and demographic characteristics and dengue hospitalization was evaluated. Of 3,964 dengue cases reported in Valle del Cauca in 2022, 2,232 (56%) were laboratory-confirmed. Of these, 1,973 occurred in the defined areas of the nine municipalities included in the spatio-temporal analysis of this study. We identified 28 clusters at the sub-municipal level, with radii of 0-0.98 km, lasting 1-6 months and containing 10-114 cases. Twenty-six clusters (92.9%) spanned both warm-dry and cool-wet seasons, and clusters accounted for 32.0% of spatially analyzed cases. 960 patients were hospitalized. Lower socioeconomic status (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.07-1.57), enrollment in the state-subsidized insurance scheme (OR 1.74, 95% CI 1.41-2.15) compared with the contributory scheme, and age ≥ 70 years compared to ages 20-29 years (OR 2.47, 95% CI 1.51-4.04) were associated with higher odds of hospitalization. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: This study identified dengue clusters at the sub-municipal level with the potential to inform reactive dengue control interventions and demonstrated a disproportionate impact on socioeconomically disadvantaged populations and the elderly in Valle del Cauca, Colombia.

title: The impact of climate variability on dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan: Post-2022 flooding.
abstract: Dengue virus is spread primarily by the Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus mosquitoes is a self-limiting viral disease primarily present in the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. Temperature and rainfall impact vector development, virus replication, and habitat suitability for Ae. albopictus larvae and pupae. Pakistan, located in Southeast Asia, is one country where DENV is endemic and impacts thousands of lives each year. In recent years, Pakistan has been hardly hit by climate change, with heavy rainfalls and flooding recurring each year, with simultaneous surges of dengue virus across the country. In this paper, we analyze the monthly dengue virus disease data from Sindh Pakistan, from 2020-2025 to understand the impacts of flooding, rainfall, and temperature fluctuations on dengue case incidence in the region. We use parametric generalized linear models and the generalized additive model. Our results indicate that monthly confirmed dengue cases exhibit a strong seasonality, with the great majority of cases concentrated in the post-monsoon months (September-November). A 1-month lag in rainfall was associated with a statistically significant increase in dengue incidence (IRR = 1.008, 95% CI: 1.003-1.012, p = 0.002), corresponding to a 0.8% increase in expected case counts per unit (mm) increase in rainfall one month prior. In contrast, neither lagged temperature term reached statistical significance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand how climate variability, specifically flooding, rainfall and temperature fluctuations, affects dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan. Dengue virus is a self-limiting viral disease primarily present in tropical and subtropical regions, with significant public health impacts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed monthly dengue virus disease data from Sindh, Pakistan, between 2020 and 2025. It focused on the impacts of climate factors on dengue case incidence in the region, with a particular emphasis on post-monsoon months.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed parametric generalized linear models and generalized additive models to assess the relationship between climate variables and dengue incidence. They examined the effects of rainfall and temperature on case counts, incorporating a 1-month lag for rainfall.
analysis.main_results: Monthly confirmed dengue cases showed strong seasonality, with the majority occurring in post-monsoon months (September-November). A 1-month lag in rainfall was associated with a statistically significant increase in dengue incidence (IRR = 1.008, 95% CI: 1.003-1.012, p = 0.002), corresponding to a 0.8% increase in expected case counts per unit (mm) increase in rainfall one month prior.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that rainfall, particularly with a 1-month lag, has a significant impact on dengue incidence, highlighting the importance of climate factors in disease dynamics. This study provides novel insights into the relationship between climate variability and dengue outbreaks in Sindh.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform public health strategies for dengue surveillance and prevention in regions experiencing climate variability, particularly in Sindh, Pakistan. Understanding these relationships may help in predicting and mitigating future outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on monthly case data and does not account for other potential factors influencing dengue incidence. The evidence is moderate, as it relies on observational data and statistical modeling without experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of climate variability, specifically flooding, rainfall, and temperature fluctuations, on dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan, from 2020 to 2025. The research highlights the strong seasonality of dengue cases, with the majority occurring in post-monsoon months. A 1-month lag in rainfall was found to be statistically significantly associated with increased dengue incidence, with an estimated 0.8% rise in case counts per unit increase in rainfall. The study employs generalized linear and additive models to analyze these relationships, offering novel insights into the role of climate factors in dengue outbreaks. These findings can inform public health strategies for surveillance and prevention in the region. However, the study's reliance on observational data and lack of experimental validation limit the strength of the evidence, which is considered moderate.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为登革热 监测 的公共卫生策略和气候变化地区的预防提供参考,特别是在巴基斯坦信德省。了解这些关系可能有助于预测和缓解未来的 暴发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于每月病例数据,并未考虑影响登革热 发病率 的其他潜在因素。证据是中等的,因为它依赖于未经实验验证的观察数据和统计模型。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为登革热 监测 的公共卫生策略和气候变化地区的预防提供参考,特别是在巴基斯坦信德省。了解这些关系可能有助于预测和缓解未来的 暴发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于每月病例数据,并未考虑影响登革热 发病率 的其他潜在因素。证据是中等的,因为它依赖于未经实验验证的观察数据和统计模型。

title: An early activated CD38highCD209highCD36low monocyte phenotype is associated with progression to severe dengue
abstract: Background: Although monocytes are among the principal target cells of dengue virus (DENV) infection we sought to investigate monocyte phenotypic markers associated with disease severity and evaluate their potential as prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Methods: Differences in monocyte subpopulations and phenotypic markers were assessed by flow cytometry in patients with dengue fever (DF=33) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF=21) and compared to health controls (HCs=20). Further in vitro experiments were done by co-culturing peripheral blood mononucleocytes (PBMCs) of healthy individuals (n=8) with DENV2, DENV3, NS1 antigen of both serotypes and LPS. The changes in expression of CD36 and CD38 in vitro in monocytes were assessed. Results: A significant expansion of intermediate monocytes and a contraction of the classical monocytes was seen in patients with DHF compared to DF and HCs, with no significant differences within the non-classical monocytes. Patients who progressed to develop DHF, exhibited an activated monocyte phenotype characterized by, expansion of CD38high, CD209high, CD86high, HLA-DRhigh, CD36low, intermediate monocyte subset. The highest expression of CD38 and CD86 was seen in non-classical monocytes, and CD209 and HLA-DR in intermediate monocytes. Most significant downregulation of CD36 was observed in non-classical monocytes. CD38 expression on monocytes (especially classical monocytes) positively and significantly correlated with liver transaminases and serum ferritin levels. Co-culture of PBMCs with DENV3 led to significant downregulation of CD36 (p=0.023). Conclusions: These results suggest that early alterations in monocyte activation, antigen presentation, viral entry, and lipid sensing pathways contribute to dengue immunopathogenesis.
authors: M H M Thisara S HETTI MUDALIGE THIS Perera
Perera, M. H. M. T. S. H. M. T. S.

title: An Integrated Review of Dengue Fever!
abstract: Dengue is the most widespread human arboviral infection, transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, with a global incidence that has risen sharply due to climate change, rapid urbanization, and the expanding distribution of mosquito vectors. This review synthesizes current knowledge on three interconnected dimensions of dengue epidemiology, pathophysiology, and molecular diagnostics to provide an integrated understanding of its evolving burden and clinical challenges. Dengue virus (DENV), comprising four distinct serotypes, causes a wide clinical spectrum from asymptomatic infection to severe disease, with antibody-dependent enhancement during secondary infections playing a key role in progression to plasma leakage, shock, and organ impairment. Globally, dengue continues to expand, with Asia carrying the highest burden; in Bangladesh, the shifting dominance of circulating serotypes and changing geographic patterns highlight the need for robust surveillance. title: From Pilot Plan to Public Trust: Community Perceptions of a Dengue Vaccine Campaign in Iquitos, Peru
abstract: Abstract Background A dengue vaccine has the potential to significantly reduce dengue transmission, severe disease, and mortality. In November 2024, Peru started to roll out the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine for children ages 10–16 in four priority regions with historically high levels of dengue transmission. This qualitative study examines facilitators and barriers to the roll out of the Qdenga vaccine from parent and health provider and authority perspectives in Iquitos, Peru. Methods Six focus group discussions (FGDs) (n = 55) with parents of eligible children and four key informant interviews (KIIs) with Loreto Regional Health Department (GERESA) nursing coordinators were conducted in Iquitos. analysis.scope_and_question: This study focuses on the implementation of the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine in Iquitos, Peru, specifically examining community perceptions and the factors influencing vaccine uptake among parents and health providers. The central question is how community trust and convenience affect the success of dengue vaccination campaigns in areas with high dengue transmission and limited access to health facilities.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study employed qualitative methods, including six focus group discussions (FGDs) with 55 parents and four key informant interviews with health department nursing coordinators. Data were collected through thematic analysis and organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR). A complementary dataset from Piura was also used to contextualize the findings.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study concludes that a centralized clinic-based strategy for dengue vaccination led to low uptake, but local health districts adapted by incorporating school-based and door-to-door outreach, which improved vaccine coverage. Trust in public health officials and convenience of these adapted strategies were identified as key facilitators of vaccine acceptance.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The use of the term 'pilot plan' in technical guidance created unintended distrust among community members, who perceived the vaccine as an experiment on children. There is a gap in understanding how different communication strategies impact vaccine acceptance in diverse settings, particularly in areas with high dengue transmission.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The study highlights the need for local health facilities to adapt national vaccination strategies to community-specific contexts. It also suggests that clear and transparent communication about vaccine implementation is crucial to building trust and ensuring high uptake in dengue-prone areas.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores community perceptions of the Qdenga dengue vaccine rollout in Iquitos, Peru, focusing on the factors influencing vaccine acceptance. The research identifies that the term 'pilot plan' in technical guidance generated distrust, with community members viewing the vaccine as an experiment. A centralized clinic-based strategy led to low uptake, but local adaptations such as school-based and door-to-door vaccination improved coverage. Trust in public health officials and convenience were key facilitators of vaccine acceptance. The findings emphasize the importance of tailoring national vaccination strategies to local contexts and improving communication to build community confidence in dengue prevention efforts.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热 疫苗 有可能显着减少登革热 传播、严重疾病和 死亡率。2024 年 11 月,秘鲁开始在登革热 传播 发病率历史最高的四个重点地区针对 10 至 16 岁儿童推出 Qdenga (TAK-003) 登革热 疫苗。这项定性研究从秘鲁伊基托斯的家长和医疗服务提供者以及权威人士的角度审视了 Qdenga 疫苗 推出的促进因素和障碍。方法 在伊基托斯与符合条件的儿童家长进行了 6 次焦点小组讨论 (FGD) (n = 55),并与洛雷托地区卫生局 (GERESA) 护理协调员进行了 4 次关键知情者访谈 (KII)。使用主题分析对录制的会议进行转录和分析,并使用实施研究综合框架 (CFIR) 进行组织。来自 Piura 的补充数据集被用来进一步将研究结果结合起来。结果 政策措辞的选择造成了意想不到的实施障碍,特别是在技术指南中使用“试点计划”一词引起了许多社区成员的不信任,他们认为自己的孩子是测试新 疫苗 安全性和有效性的计划中的“小白鼠”。基于诊所的策略的集中计划导致采用率较低,因此当地卫生区调整了策略,让学校参与并进行挨家挨户的 疫苗接种 外展,最终实现了第一剂 疫苗接种 目标。信任和便利是相辅相成的,因为参与者报告了对公共卫生官员的高度信任,并对学校和挨家挨户的策略表示赞赏。结论 在前往医疗机构的交通存在困难且社区对 疫苗接种 计划表示犹豫的情况下,本研究表明,在参与者及其子女所在地开展强有力的实地公共卫生活动是确保 疫苗 吸收的有效策略。它还表明当地卫生机构有效地将国家 疫苗接种 运动战略适应当地环境的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该研究强调地方卫生机构需要根据社区特定情况调整国家 疫苗接种 战略。它还表明,有关 疫苗 实施的清晰、透明的沟通对于在登革热多发地区建立信任和确保高采用率至关重要。

title: A CBC-derived score associated with dengue NS1 antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in Dhaka: a retrospective model-development study
abstract: Abstract Background Early diagnostic triage for suspected dengue is important in high-volume settings, yet confirmatory testing may be delayed or intermittently available. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a simple complete blood count (CBC)-derived score to estimate the likelihood of same-day dengue non-structural protein 1 (NS1) antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Methods We conducted a retrospective model-development study at Uttara Adhunik Medical College Hospital using data from patients with clinical suspicion of dengue between 19 August and 12 October 2023. The final analysis included 596 unique patients who underwent CBC and NS1 testing on the same day. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) penalized logistic regression was used for variable selection among routinely available demographic and hematological predictors. Selected predictors were refit using unpenalized logistic regression to derive a CBC score. Internal validation and calibration were assessed using bootstrap optimism correction with 400 resamples. Results Among 596 patients, 306 (51.3%) were NS1 positive. The final parsimonious model retained platelet count rescaled per 10 x 10 9 /L, white blood cell count, and monocyte count. The optimism-corrected AUC was 0.9429. At the Youden-derived cutoff of 11.825, the final integer score had sensitivity 0.833 (95% CI, 0.787-0.873), specificity 0.966 (95% CI, 0.938-0.983), PPV 0.962 (95% CI, 0.932-0.982), NPV 0.846 (95% CI, 0.802-0.883), and accuracy 0.898 (95% CI, 0.870-0.921). A rounded cutoff of 12 produced similar performance. In benchmark analysis, the final model showed a modest improvement over platelet count alone (AUC 0.944 vs 0.931; Delta AUC 0.012; DeLong p=0.00364). Conclusion A three-parameter CBC score can estimate the likelihood of NS1 antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in this single-center dataset. The score should be interpreted as a CBC-only triage adjunct, not as a replacement for confirmatory dengue testing. External validation in independent cohorts is needed before routine clinical use.

title: Using Real-Time Health Care Provider Feedback to Guide Response Efforts During a Dengue Outbreak, US Virgin Islands, 2024-2025.
abstract: During 2024, a dengue outbreak occurred in the US Virgin Islands (USVI). To guide response efforts, we assessed health care providers' practices, experiences, and needs related to dengue diagnostics, clinical management, and reporting during the ongoing outbreak. A rapid needs assessment was conducted using semi-structured interviews with 9 clinicians across the USVI. Interview data were coded into predefined topic areas and analyzed to identify key gaps and actionable opportunities for support. Outcomes revealed gaps in clinical training, diagnostic support, and clinician-community engagement. Providers reported limited confidence in recognizing warning signs and expressed a need for additional training and decision-making tools. Findings indicated that clinicians often relied on clinical judgment for diagnosis but faced challenges related to diagnostic testing, including cost, long turnaround times, and uncertainty about test selection. Gaps in community awareness and misconceptions about dengue transmission were also identified. The rapid needs assessment was led by the Virgin Islands Department of Health and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and results informed rapid implementation of targeted interventions, including clinician training resources, expanded diagnostic testing pathways, and enhanced community outreach efforts, such as streamlined diagnostic testing processes and community outreach. This case study highlights the value of rapid assessments in guiding timely public health responses during outbreaks through provider-centered feedback.

title_zh: 使用实时医疗保健提供者反馈来指导登革热 暴发 期间的应对工作,美属维尔京群岛,2024-2025 年。
source_body_en: During 2024, a dengue outbreak occurred in the US Virgin Islands (USVI). To guide response efforts, we assessed health care providers' practices, experiences, and needs related to dengue diagnostics, clinical management, and reporting during the ongoing outbreak. A rapid needs assessment was conducted using semi-structured interviews with 9 clinicians across the USVI. Interview data were coded into predefined topic areas and analyzed to identify key gaps and actionable opportunities for support. Outcomes revealed gaps in clinical training, diagnostic support, and clinician-community engagement. Providers reported limited confidence in recognizing warning signs and expressed a need for additional training and decision-making tools. Findings indicated that clinicians often relied on clinical judgment for diagnosis but faced challenges related to diagnostic testing, including cost, long turnaround times, and uncertainty about test selection. Gaps in community awareness and misconceptions about dengue transmission were also identified. The rapid needs assessment was led by the Virgin Islands Department of Health and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and results informed rapid implementation of targeted interventions, including clinician training resources, expanded diagnostic testing pathways, and enhanced community outreach efforts, such as streamlined diagnostic testing processes and community outreach. This case study highlights the value of rapid assessments in guiding timely public health responses during outbreaks through provider-centered feedback.

title: Adult Immunogenicity and Descriptive Safety of TAK-003 Dengue Vaccination: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
abstract: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the immunogenicity and safety of the final two-dose formulation of TAK-003 in adults. Dengue viruses 1–4 and dengue disease are the target entities, with other flaviviruses considered near-neighbour exclusions. The central question is to synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety data for the licensed TAK-003 vaccine.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes records from PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations. The review used a reproducible computational workflow for screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled using binomial-normal logit models, while comparative reactogenicity was analyzed using random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled seropositivity estimates for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4 were 98.7%, 99.0%, 96.9%, and 98.4%, respectively, 30 days after dose 2. The SAE risk was 2.0% (95% CI 1.4–2.8) across four cohorts. The final-formulation TAK-003 demonstrated high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Certainty was graded as low or very low due to study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Pain and headache estimates were highly imprecise, with each derived from only two studies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to improve certainty in safety assessments and to address the imprecision in reactogenicity estimates. Surveillance and risk assessment should focus on long-term safety and efficacy, particularly in diverse populations and regions. Additional studies are required to evaluate the vaccine's performance in different serostatus groups and to refine outcome definitions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluate the immunogenicity and safety of the final two-dose formulation of TAK-003 in adults. The review synthesized data from five trials, reporting high seropositivity rates (98.7–99.0%) for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4 30 days post-vaccination. The pooled risk of serious adverse events (SAE) was 2.0% (95% CI 1.4–2.8) through day 270. However, certainty was low or very low due to study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data. Pain and headache estimates were imprecise, with each derived from only two studies. The review highlights the need for further research to improve safety assessments and address reactogenicity imprecision, as well as to refine outcome definitions and evaluate vaccine performance in diverse populations.

title_zh: TAK-003 登革热 疫苗接种 的成人免疫原性和描述性安全性:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.
abstract_zh: 背景:成人 TAK-003 数据因配方、基线登革热状态、共同给药和结果定义而异。目的:合成获得许可的 TAK-003 两剂量最终制剂的成人免疫原性和安全性。方法:我们检索了 PubMed、Scopus、CENTRAL 衍生记录、注册、监管来源和最终检索更新的引用。筛选、提取、评估和分析使用可重复的计算工作流程,无需独立的重复验证。使用二项正态 Logit 模型对血清阳性率和 270 天严重不良事件 (SAE) 风险进行建模;比较反应原性使用随机效应风险比和修正的 Hartung-Knapp 区间。确定性按结果分级,敏感性分析添加了单臂 DEN307 队列研究。结果:在 1,090 条记录中,筛选了 606 条独特记录(553 条出版物和 53 条登记记录);排除 473 篇出版物,检索 80 篇。五项试验提供了定量结果。在 620 名基线血清阴性成人中,第 2 剂给药后约 30 天,DENV-1 的汇总血清阳性率为 98.7%(95% CI 95.8-99.6),DENV-2 为 99.0%(97.9-99.6),DENV-3 为 96.9%(95.2-98.0),DENV-4 为 98.4% (97.0–99.1)。添加 DEN307 后,估计值为 98.8%、99.2%、97.1% 和 98.5%(每种血清型 752 名参与者)。在四个 队列研究 中,29/1,468 名参与者在第 270 天出现 SAE(合并风险 2.0%,95% CI 1.4–2.8)。两项研究对疼痛和头痛的估计都非常不精确。结论:最终制剂 TAK-003 在选定的成人试验人群中显示出较高的短期血清阳性率。SAE 风险不受控制,无法建立相对安全性。确定性很低或非常低,并且推断受到研究规模、替代结果和不受控制的安全性数据的限制。

title: Divergências in silico nos sítios de anelamento de RT-qPCR do vírus da dengue e correção do conjunto afetado In silico divergences at RT-qPCR annealing sites of dengue virus and correction of the affected primer-probe set
abstract: Dengue comprises four serotypes with wide genetic diversity, and mutations in the regions recognised by primers and probes may compromise the reliability of RT-qPCR assays. This study assessed the impact of such divergences on the annealing sites of a fourplex RT-qPCR assay for serotype-specific detection of DENV, published in 2005, and proposed a corrected set for the most affected serotype. This is a descriptive-analytical study with an in silico approach. Twenty-four complete genomes, six per serotype, were retrieved from NCBI and formed the main panel, expanded to 45 DENV-3 and 48 DENV-2 genomes for the detailed analyses. The twelve oligonucleotides of the assay were located in each genome by local alignment against both strands, with coordinates validated against the positions published in the original protocol. Divergences were observed in all twelve oligonucleotides. Seven events fell within the five bases of the 3′ end of primers, distributed across DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4, with none in DENV-1. The sense primer D3-F proved the most compromised component, since the substitution at position 18, two bases from the 3′ end, was present in 45 of the 45 DENV-3 genomes analysed, from different countries and collection periods, so that the published oligonucleotide shows perfect pairing in none of them. Complete redesign of the DENV-3 set proved unfeasible. Of the 10,707 genome positions, 8,268 (77.2%) are conserved, yet only 23 stretches reach 18 nucleotides and merely three can host an oligonucleotide able to discriminate the remaining serotypes, separated from one another by thousands of bases. In the 3′ untranslated region, all 25 sets generated contained at least one component identical to another serotype. Correction of the existing oligonucleotides through degenerate bases was therefore adopted, raising perfect pairing of D3-F from none to 44 of the 45 genomes. It is concluded that intra-serotypic conservation and serotype specificity compete for the same genomic region and that monitoring of diagnostic sites should be incorporated into routine genomic surveillance.
authors: Maria Bárbara de Holanda Cavalcante Ubaldo Monteiro e Barbosa

title: UNCOVERING THE POTENTIAL OF NIRAGA TEA POLYHERBALTM AS AN ANTIOXIDANT AND ANTIVIRAL AGENT AGAINST DENGUE: INSIGHTS FROM IN VITRO AND IN SILICO APPROACHES
abstract: Dengue is a vector-borne disease with a high health burden in tropical regions, yet no specific antiviral therapy is currently available. This study aimed to investigate the antioxidant activity, cytotoxicity, and antiviral activity against dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) of the Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM formulation and performed phytochemical profiling and molecular docking. GC‒MS and FT‒IR analyses were used to analyze the profiles and structures of bioactive compounds; antioxidant activity was evaluated using the DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP methods; dengue antiviral activity was evaluated using the Viral ToxGlo assay; and cytotoxicity was evaluated using Vero cells in an MTT assay. Molecular docking evaluations of the compounds targeting the DENV-2 NS5 protein in silico. GC‒MS characterization revealed 100 compounds, predominantly methyl oleate (69.60%) and ethyl pentadecanoate (20.84%), along with quercetin (0.46%) and epigallocatechin gallate (0.19%). FT-IR analysis confirmed that phenolic hydroxyl groups were the dominant functional groups. DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays revealed IC50 values of 20.79, 21.34, and 18.80 μg/mL, respectively. MTT assays of Vero cells yielded a CC50 value of 1207 μg/mL. Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM significantly inhibited the cytopathic effects (F= 42.50; p=0.005), with an EC50 of 10.32 μg/mL and a selectivity index (SI) of 116.96 against DENV-2. Molecular binding studies of methyl oleate and ethyl pentadecanoate to DENV-2 NS5 revealed weak binding affinities (ΔG -3.95 to -4.31 kcal/mol), which were weaker than those observed with more potent in vitro compounds. In conclusion, Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM has the potential to be developed as a candidate phytopharmaceutical for dengue antiviral therapy with a high safety profile against host cells.

GC‒MS and FT‒IR analyses were used to analyze the profiles and structures of bioactive compounds; antioxidant activity was evaluated using the DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP methods; dengue antiviral activity was evaluated using the Viral ToxGlo assay; and cytotoxicity was evaluated using Vero cells in an MTT assay. Molecular docking evaluations of the compounds targeting the DENV-2 NS5 protein in silico. GC‒MS characterization revealed 100 compounds, predominantly methyl oleate (69.60%) and ethyl pentadecanoate (20.84%), along with quercetin (0.46%) and epigallocatechin gallate (0.19%). FT-IR analysis confirmed that phenolic hydroxyl groups were the dominant functional groups. DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays revealed IC50 values of 20.79, 21.34, and 18.80 μg/mL, respectively. MTT assays of Vero cells yielded a CC50 value of 1207 μg/mL. Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM significantly inhibited the cytopathic effects (F= 42.50; p=0.005), with an EC50 of 10.32 μg/mL and a selectivity index (SI) of 116.96 against DENV-2. Molecular binding studies of methyl oleate and ethyl pentadecanoate to DENV-2 NS5 revealed weak binding affinities (ΔG -3.95 to -4.31 kcal/mol), which were weaker than those observed with more potent in vitro compounds. In conclusion, Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM has the potential to be developed as a candidate phytopharmaceutical for dengue antiviral therapy with a high safety profile against host cells.

The research aimed to evaluate the formulation's properties through phytochemical profiling and molecular docking.
