title_zh: 揭示 NIRAGA 茶复方作为抗氧化剂和 抗病毒药物 抗登革热药物的潜力:来自体外和计算机方法的见解
source_body_en: Dengue is a vector-borne disease with a high health burden in tropical regions, yet no specific antiviral therapy is currently available. This study aimed to investigate the antioxidant activity, cytotoxicity, and antiviral activity against dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) of the Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM formulation and performed phytochemical profiling and molecular docking. GC‒MS and FT‒IR analyses were used to analyze the profiles and structures of bioactive compounds; antioxidant activity was evaluated using the DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP methods; dengue antiviral activity was evaluated using the Viral ToxGlo assay; and cytotoxicity was evaluated using Vero cells in an MTT assay. Molecular docking evaluations of the compounds targeting the DENV-2 NS5 protein in silico. GC‒MS characterization revealed 100 compounds, predominantly methyl oleate (69.60%) and ethyl pentadecanoate (20.84%), along with quercetin (0.46%) and epigallocatechin gallate (0.19%). FT-IR analysis confirmed that phenolic hydroxyl groups were the dominant functional groups. DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays revealed IC50 values of 20.79, 21.34, and 18.80 μg/mL, respectively. MTT assays of Vero cells yielded a CC50 value of 1207 μg/mL. Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM significantly inhibited the cytopathic effects (F= 42.50; p=0.005), with an EC50 of 10.32 μg/mL and a selectivity index (SI) of 116.96 against DENV-2. Molecular binding studies of methyl oleate and ethyl pentadecanoate to DENV-2 NS5 revealed weak binding affinities (ΔG -3.95 to -4.31 kcal/mol), which were weaker than those observed with more potent in vitro compounds. In conclusion, Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM has the potential to be developed as a candidate phytopharmaceutical for dengue antiviral therapy with a high safety profile against host cells.
abstract_zh: 登革热是一种 媒介 传播的疾病,在热带地区造成很高的健康负担,但目前尚无特定的 抗病毒药物 治疗方法。本研究旨在研究 Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM 配方的抗氧化活性、细胞毒性和针对 登革病毒 血清型 2 (DENV-2) 的 抗病毒药物 活性,并进行植物化学分析和分子对接。使用GC-MS和FT-IR分析来分析生物活性化合物的概况和结构;使用DPPH、ABTS和FRAP方法评价抗氧化活性;使用 Viral ToxGlo 测定评估登革热 抗病毒药物 活性;并使用 Vero 细胞在 MTT 测定中评估细胞毒性。在计算机上对靶向 DENV-2 NS5 蛋白的化合物进行分子对接评估。GC-MS 表征显示了 100 种化合物,主要是油酸甲酯 (69.60%) 和十五烷酸乙酯 (20.84%),以及槲皮素 (0.46%) 和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯 (0.19%)。FT-IR 分析证实酚羟基是主要官能团。DPPH、ABTS 和 FRAP 测定显示 IC50 值分别为 20.79、21.34 和 18.80 μg/mL。Vero 细胞的 MTT 测定得出的 CC50 值为 1207 μg/mL。Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM 显着抑制细胞病变效应(F= 42.50;p=0.005),针对 DENV-2 的 EC50 为 10.32 μg/mL,选择性指数 (SI) 为 116.96。油酸甲酯和十五烷酸乙酯与 DENV-2 NS5 的分子结合研究揭示了较弱的结合亲和力(ΔG -3.95 至 -4.31 kcal/mol),比用更有效的体外化合物观察到的结合亲和力弱。总之,Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM 有潜力被开发为登革热 抗病毒药物 治疗的候选植物药物,并且对 宿主 细胞具有高安全性。

title: Glycosylation of the Premembrane Protein Is Required for Dengue Virus Replication in Both C6/36 and Vero Cells
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne, positive sense, single-stranded RNA virus that includes four serotypes (DENV1-4) that are further divided into distinct genotypes within a serotype. DENV causes approximately 100 million human infections each year. DENV virions encode a capisd surrounded by a lipid bilayer that encodes two glycoproteins, E and prM. During virion maturation, the premembrane protein (prM) is cleaved to form a mature virion, which includes partially mature and fully mature particles. The maturity state of the DENV virion affects both the infectivity of DENVs and the ability of antibodies to neutralize the virus. The prM glycoprotein is glycosylated and highly conserved across all DENVs. In particular, the N-linked glycosylation site at position 69 is present in over 99% of DENV genomes. In this manuscript, we investigated the importance of the N69 glycosylation site by generating both DENV2 and DENV4 loss-of-function viruses. These N69 glycosylation knockout viruses were generated by introducing a single amino acid mutation at site 69. Neither mutant virus had detectable titers despite multiple passages in vitro. To further investigate the importance of the glycosylation site, we generated another variation in which the N-linked glycosylation site was repositioned to a site proximal to residue 69. One of these proximal-glycosylation mutants showed viral replication at levels that approached wild-type (WT) DENV strains. Overall, this study demonstrated the importance of retaining an N-linked glycan on the prM protein at position 69 for DENV infectivity of mosquito cells and that inserting a glycosylation site in close proximity to position 69 may restore infectivity in some DENV4 strains.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of DENV replication and infectivity, which could inform the development of targeted antiviral strategies and improve understanding of viral evolution and pathogenesis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the N69 glycosylation site on the prM protein of dengue virus (DENV) in viral replication and infectivity. The researchers generated loss-of-function viruses for DENV2 and DENV4 by introducing a single amino acid mutation at site 69 and tested their replication in mosquito cells. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革病毒 (DENV) prM 蛋白上的 N69 糖基化位点对病毒复制和感染性的重要性。登革病毒 是一种蚊媒、正义、单链 RNA 病毒,包括四种血清型 (DENV1-4),在血清型内进一步分为不同的基因型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及通过在 N69 糖基化位点引入单个氨基酸 突变 来生成 DENV2 和 DENV4 的功能丧失病毒。测试了这些突变病毒在蚊子细胞中的体外复制能力,并与野生型登革热病毒株进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过在 69 位点引入单个氨基酸 突变 来创建 N69 糖基化敲除病毒。然后,他们评估了蚊子细胞中的病毒复制,并评估了这些突变病毒与野生型 DENV 毒株相比的感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管在体外多次传代,两种 N69 糖基化敲除病毒都没有可检测到的滴度。其中一种近端糖基化突变体的病毒复制水平接近野生型 (WT) DENV 毒株。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,在 prM 蛋白 69 位保留 N 连接聚糖对于蚊子细胞的 DENV 感染性至关重要。他们还指出,在 69 位附近插入糖基化位点可能会恢复某些 DENV4 菌株的感染性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对 DENV 复制和感染性的分子机制的见解,这可以为靶向 抗病毒药物 策略的开发提供信息,并提高对病毒 进化 和 发病机制 的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外实验,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据是中等的,因为它基于实验室观察,没有临床或流行病学数据。

title: Spatial Mapping of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever Cases and Primary Healthcare Accessibility in the Oesapa Health Center Catchment, Kupang City, Indonesia
abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a recurrent public health problem in tropical cities, where localized transmission and unequal access to primary healthcare can delay early case management. This study aimed to map the distribution of dengue cases and evaluate the spatial accessibility of existing community health services in the Oesapa Health Center catchment, Kupang City, Indonesia. A descriptive quantitative design was combined with geographic information system analysis. Secondary dengue surveillance records for 2023, field-verified case coordinates, administrative boundaries, and health-facility locations were integrated in ArcGIS. Case distribution was summarized by sex, age group, and kelurahan, while a 3,000-m service buffer was used to assess potential reach from Oesapa Health Center to recorded case locations. Kupang City reported 199 dengue cases in 2023, and the Oesapa Health Center catchment accounted for the highest health-center total, with 35 cases or 17.6% of the citywide burden. Within the catchment, cases were concentrated in Oesapa and Lasiana, which together contributed 25 cases or 71.4% of the local total. Adults aged 18-59 years represented the largest age group with 21 cases or 60.0%, while female patients accounted for 57.1% of cases. Buffer analysis indicated that 29 of 35 cases, or 82.9%, were located within the 3,000-m potential service catchment, leaving six cases outside the primary buffer. The findings show that micro-scale dengue mapping can identify priority neighborhoods and reveal residual access gaps within an apparently well-served urban health-center area.

title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes the epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas. The review, conducted between 2012 and 2025, included 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO. Key findings indicate a global increase in dengue incidence since 1990, with significant regional variations and a high burden in Latin America. Chikungunya expanded across the Americas starting in 2013, causing explosive urban outbreaks with persistent joint manifestations. Urbanization, the spread of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, and insecticide resistance are identified as factors that facilitated transmission. The review highlights the need for sustained surveillance and control measures, emphasizing the potential of new vaccines and integrated vector control as strategies. The evidence suggests that both arboviruses pose a growing threat to tropical and subtropical urban populations.

title: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas: revisión sistemática Dengue prevention strategies in urban communities: a systematic review
abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates dengue prevention strategies in urban communities, focusing on their effectiveness and applicability in Ecuador. The evidence base includes 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO, spanning 2012 to 2025, encompassing systematic reviews, community interventions, and economic evaluations. Key findings indicate that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, such as environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, yielded the most favorable outcomes. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without clear evidence of impact on transmission. The review emphasizes the need for strategies that incorporate epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services to effectively prevent dengue in urban settings. The study also notes that factors like water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention success in Ecuador. The implications suggest a focus on community engagement and long-term, sustainable interventions to address dengue in urban populations.

source_body_en: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

title: An Analysis of the SIR Model and Stability of Dengue Fever Spread in Tangerang Regency
abstract: Penyakit yang berbahaya dan bisa menyebabkan kematian jika tidak ditangani dengan tepat di Indonesia salah satunya Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD). Demam Berdarah Dengue menjadi penyakit yang saat ini berkembang di dunia dan masih menjadi masalah kebanyakan masyarakat di Indonesia khususnya di Kabupaten Tangerang. Dalam mengatasi penyebaran penyakit ini, analisis model matematika SIR dapat digunakan untuk pemahaman dan memprediksi dinamika penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD). Jenis penelitian ini adalah studi kepustakaan dan penelitian kuantitatif. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui model penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) menggunakan model SIR, analisis dinamik, titik ekuilibrium, kestabilan titik ekuilibrium dan simulasi numerik model matematika SIR pada penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) di Kabupaten Tangerang. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa model matematika SIR efektif dalam memodelkan dan menganalisis kesatbilan penyebaran penyakit penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) di Kabupaten Tangerang. Penelitian ini memberikan konstribusi penting dalam menanggulangi dan mengetahui kestabilan penyebaran penyakit.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究有助于了解如何管理和稳定 登革热 在唐格朗县的传播。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于对数学模型的依赖,没有提供直接的经验数据,因此证据强度中等。

title: Arboviroses e suas manifestações musculoesqueléticas subsídios para o diagnóstico diferencial entre dengue, Chikungunya e Zika
abstract: Introdução: Dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, transmitidas pelo Aedes aegypti, cocirculam no Brasil e compartilham manifestações iniciais, o que dificulta o diagnóstico diferencial.Objetivo: Caracterizar o quadro clínico de dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, com ênfase nos sintomas musculoesqueléticos e constitucionais, e sistematizar elementos para o diagnóstico diferencial. Métodos: Revisão narrativa nas bases SciELO, LILACS e PubMed/MEDLINE, com publicações de 2012 a 2026, complementada por documentos do Ministério da Saúde e recomendações da Sociedade Brasileira de Reumatologia. Resultados: Na dengue, predominam febre alta por dois a sete dias, mialgia intensa e artralgia leve, com risco de extravasamento plasmático na defervescência. Na Chikungunya, mais de 90% dos pacientes apresentam poliatralgia simétrica e incapacitante, com edema e tenossinovite, e cerca de metade evolui para doença crônica, por vezes com artrite erosiva. Na Zika, a febre é baixa ou ausente, o exantema pruriginoso é precoce, a conjuntivite é frequente e a artralgia é discreta; a infecção congênita pode cursar com artrogripose. Trombocitopenia sugere dengue, e linfopenia, Chikungunya. O RT-PCR é indicado é indicado até o quinto dia e a sorologia a partir do sexto, com reação cruzada entre flavivírus. Anti-inflamatórios e corticosteroides devem ser evitados até que a dengue seja afastada. Conclusão: O padrão musculoesquelético, associado ao comportamento da febre e do exantema, orienta o diagnóstico diferencial nos primeiros dias; a cronificação da Chikungunya exige seguimento estruturado e manejo da dor conforme a fase da doença.
authors: Mateus Dornelas Mitchell Paiva De Almeida
Maria Helena Queiroz de Araújo Mariano
journal: Brazilian Journal of Implantology and Health Sciences

Métodos: Revisão narrativa nas bases SciELO, LILACS e PubMed/MEDLINE, com publicações de 2012 a 2026, complementada por documentos do Ministério da Saúde e recomendações da Sociedade Brasileira de Reumatologia. Resultados: Na dengue, predominam febre alta por dois a sete dias, mialgia intensa e artralgia leve, com risco de extravasamento plasmático na defervescência. Na Chikungunya, mais de 90% dos pacientes apresentam poliatralgia simétrica e incapacitante, com edema e tenossinovite, e cerca de metade evolui para doença crônica, por vezes com artrite erosiva. Na Zika, a febre é baixa ou ausente, o exantema pruriginoso é precoce, a conjuntivite é frequente e a artralgia é discreta; a infecção congênita pode cursar com artrogripose. Trombocitopenia sugere dengue, e linfopenia, Chikungunya. O RT-PCR é indicado é indicado até o quinto dia e a sorologia a partir do sexto, com reação cruzada entre flavivírus. Anti-inflamatórios e corticosteroides devem ser evitados até que a dengue seja afastada. Conclusão: O padrão musculoesquelético, associado ao comportamento da febre e do exantema, orienta o diagnóstico diferencial nos primeiros dias; a cronificação da Chikungunya exige seguimento estruturado e manejo da dor conforme a fase da doença.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the clinical picture of dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika, with emphasis on musculoskeletal and constitutional symptoms, and to systematize elements for differential diagnosis. The scientific/public-health problem is the difficulty in differentiating these arboviroses due to their overlapping initial manifestations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A narrative review was conducted using SciELO, LILACS, and PubMed/MEDLINE databases from 2012 to 2026, supplemented by Ministry of Health documents and recommendations from the Brazilian Society of Rheumatology.
analysis.methods: The review included RT-PCR for dengue until the fifth day and serology from the sixth day, with cross-reactivity between flaviviruses. Anti-inflammatory and corticosteroid use was advised to be avoided until dengue was ruled out.
analysis.main_results: Dengue presents with high fever for two to seven days, intense myalgia, and mild arthralgia, with risk of plasma extravasation during defervescence. Chikungunya is characterized by more than 90% of patients with symmetrical and incapacitating polyarthralgia, edema, and tenosynovitis, with about half evolving to chronic disease, sometimes with erosive arthritis. Zika has low or absent fever, pruriginous exanthem, frequent conjunctivitis, and mild arthralgia; congenital infection may result in arthrogryposis. Trombocytopenia suggests dengue, and lymphopenia suggests Chikungunya.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that the musculoskeletal pattern, associated with fever and exanthem behavior, guides differential diagnosis in the early days; chronic Chikungunya requires structured follow-up and pain management according to the disease phase.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of these arboviroses, particularly in the early stages, and highlight the importance of distinguishing between them to prevent misdiagnosis and inappropriate treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on narrative review and the absence of randomized controlled trials, which may affect the strength of the evidence. The evidence is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to differentiate dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika based on clinical manifestations, particularly musculoskeletal symptoms. It reviewed literature from 2012 to 2026 and highlighted the importance of early diagnosis to prevent mismanagement of these arboviroses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述登革热、寨卡热和基孔肯雅热的临床表现,特别关注肌肉骨骼和全身症状,并系统化用于鉴别诊断的要素。科学/公共卫生问题在于,由于这些虫媒病毒病的初始表现重叠,鉴别诊断存在困难。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过SciELO、LILACS和PubMed/MEDLINE数据库从2012年至2026年进行了叙述性综述,同时补充了卫生部文件和巴西风湿病学会的建议。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述包括登革热病毒的RT-PCR检测直至第五天,第六天起使用血清学,且存在黄病毒属之间的交叉反应。建议在排除登革热之前避免使用抗炎药物和糖皮质激素。
elements_zh.main_results: Dengue presents with high fever for two to seven days, intense myalgia, and mild arthralgia, with risk of plasma extravasation during defervescence. Chikungunya is characterized by more than 90% of patients with symmetrical and incapacitating polyarthralgia, edema, and tenosynovitis, with about half evolving to chronic disease, sometimes with erosive arthritis. Zika has low or absent fever, pruriginous exanthem, frequent conjunctivitis, and mild arthralgia; congenital infection may result in arthrogryposis. Trombocytopenia suggests dengue, and lymphopenia suggests Chikungunya.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究认为,与发热和皮疹行为相关的肌肉骨骼模式指导了早期的诊断鉴别诊断;慢性寨卡病毒需要结构化的随访和根据疾病阶段进行的疼痛管理。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为这些虫媒病毒的监测、诊断和治疗提供信息,尤其是在早期阶段,并强调区分它们的重要性,以防止误诊和不适当的治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其依赖于叙述性综述以及缺乏随机对照试验,这可能影响证据的强度。证据等级为中等。

abstract_zh: 引言:登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热均由埃及伊蚊传播,在巴西同时流行,且具有相似的初期表现,这给鉴别诊断带来困难。目标:描述登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热的临床特征,特别是肌肉骨骼和全身症状,并系统化鉴别诊断要素。方法:通过SciELO、LILACS和PubMed/MEDLINE数据库进行叙述性综述,时间范围为2012年至2026年,同时结合卫生部文件和巴西风湿病学会的建议。结果:登革热表现为高热持续2至7天,伴有剧烈肌肉疼痛和轻度关节痛,退热期有血浆渗漏的风险。基孔肯雅热则超过90%的患者出现对称性且致残的多关节痛,伴有水肿和腱鞘炎,约有一半患者发展为慢性疾病,有时表现为侵蚀性关节炎。寨卡热则以低热或无热为主,早期出现瘙痒性皮疹,常见结膜炎,关节痛较轻;先天性感染可能导致关节僵硬。血小板减少提示登革热,淋巴细胞减少提示基孔肯雅热。RT-PCR适用于登革热诊断,建议在发病后第五天内进行,而血清学检测则从第六天开始,且存在黄病毒属之间的交叉反应。在排除登革热之前,应避免使用抗炎药和糖皮质激素。结论:肌肉骨骼表现模式,结合发热和皮疹的发展情况,有助于早期鉴别诊断;基孔肯雅热的慢性化需要结构化的随访和根据疾病阶段进行疼痛管理。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现可为登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热的诊断、治疗和监测提供依据,特别是在早期阶段,强调区分这些蚊媒病毒的重要性,以防止误诊和不当治疗。局限性与证据强度:本研究依赖叙述性综述,缺乏随机对照试验,这可能影响证据的强度。证据等级为中等。

title: DENGUE ALÉM DOS GRANDES CENTROS: SÉRIE HISTÓRICA DE 12 ANOS EM UM MUNICÍPIO BRASILEIRO DE PEQUENO PORTE
abstract: A dengue constitui importante problema de saúde pública no Brasil, devido à sua elevada capacidade de disseminação, recorrência epidêmica, impacto assistencial e influência de fatores ambientais, sociais e climáticos. Este estudo analisou o perfil epidemiológico e endêmico da dengue no município de Padre Paraíso, Minas Gerais, entre 2014 e 2025, em comparação com o cenário estadual. Trata-se de um estudo ecológico de série histórica, com abordagem quantitativa, realizado a partir de dados do SINAN/TABNET/DATASUS e do IBGE. Foram analisados indicadores epidemiológicos, informações sociodemográficas, desfechos clínicos e circulação sorotípica do vírus da dengue. A endemicidade foi avaliada por meio de canal endêmico baseado em mediana e quartis dos coeficientes de incidência por semana epidemiológica considerando o período 2014 a 2025. O município apresentou ciclos epidêmicos sincronizados ao cenário estadual, porém com maior intensidade proporcional e padrão sazonal recorrente entre as semanas epidemiológicas 8 e 25. Observou-se prevalência de casos para o sexo feminino, faixa etária de 20 a 59 anos e em indivíduos pardos. Não houve registro de óbitos por dengue no município, enquanto Minas Gerais apresentou óbitos em todos os anos.

abstract_zh: 登革热是巴西重要的公共卫生问题,由于其高度的传播能力、疫情反复、医疗负担以及环境、社会和气候因素的影响。本研究分析了2014年至2025年间巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州Padre Paraíso市镇的登革热流行病学和地方性特征,并与州级情况进行了比较。这是一项基于历史数据的生态学研究,采用定量分析方法,数据来源于SINAN/TABNET/DATASUS和IBGE。研究分析了流行病学指标、社会人口学信息、临床结局以及登革病毒血清型的循环情况。地方性通过基于中位数和四分位数的发病率中位数和四分位数计算的流行病学通道进行评估,时间范围为2014年至2025年。该市镇的疫情周期与州级情况同步,但发病率比例更高,且在流行病学周8至25之间呈现出反复的季节性模式。观察到病例主要集中在女性、20至59岁年龄组以及混血种人中。该市镇未记录登革热死亡病例,而米纳斯吉拉斯州每年均有登革热死亡病例。

title: Nationwide evaluation of district-informed bottom-up and direct national approaches for one-week-ahead forecasting of dengue hospital admissions in Bangladesh
abstract: Abstract Dengue places recurrent pressure on surveillance and hospital services in Bangladesh, yet most Bangladesh-focused forecasting studies have used national or temporally aggregated data. Whether retaining district-level information before national aggregation provides additional value for short-range forecasting remains uncertain. This study evaluated district-informed and direct national approaches for one-week-ahead forecasting of reported dengue hospital admissions across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. A nationwide surveillance–meteorological panel for 2022–2025 comprised 93,504 district-day observations aggregated into 13,312 complete district-week records. Admissions were organized by reporting district, not patient residence. A single pooled district-week Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) generated district-specific forecasts that were summed to obtain national predictions. This bottom-up approach was compared with direct national LightGBM, a negative binomial generalized additive model, one-week persistence, and hierarchical forecasting benchmarks. Model development was temporally ordered: 2024 was used for validation and model selection, finalized specifications were refitted using all pre-2025 model-ready data, and models remained fixed throughout the 52-week 2025 evaluation. Because model specifications were revised during peer review after initial 2025 results were known, 2025 was held out from model fitting but is not treated as an entirely untouched test set. Bottom-up LightGBM achieved the lowest observed national point error in 2025 (MAE = 239.37; RMSE = 380.27; wMAPE = 12.10%; R2 = 0.9625), compared with the direct national negative binomial generalized additive model (wMAPE = 14.85%), one-week persistence (15.65%), and direct national LightGBM (18.67%). At district-week level, improvement over persistence was modest (wMAPE = 28.34% vs. All three primary 95% circular block-bootstrap confidence intervals for the primary national wMAPE differences crossed zero, and adjusted predictive-accuracy tests did not establish statistical superiority. Hierarchical reconciliation did not reduce national point error below the unreconciled bottom-up forecast. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified recent admissions as the dominant predictive signal, while additional analyses showed geographic heterogeneity in forecast-error magnitude. The empirical 95% residual-based uncertainty interval covered 49 of 52 held-out weeks (94.23%). District-informed bottom-up forecasting achieved the lowest observed national point error while retaining subnational forecast information, but its advantage over strong comparators remained statistically uncertain. Prospective multi-season validation is required before routine early-warning use.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热对孟加拉国的监测和医院服务造成持续压力,但大多数以孟加拉国为中心的预测研究都使用了国家级或时间聚合的数据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了基于区级信息和直接国家级方法在孟加拉国所有64个区的一周期前登革热住院病例预测。
elements_zh.methods: 一个单一的区级周数据池Light Gradient Boosting Machine(LightGBM)生成了区级特定的预测,并将这些预测汇总以获得国家级预测。本研究采用前瞻性多季节验证方法,其中2024年用于验证和模型选择,最终的模型规格使用所有2025年前的模型可用数据重新拟合。
elements_zh.main_results: 自下而上的LightGBM在2025年实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差(MAE = 239.37;RMSE = 380.27;wMAPE = 12.10%;R2 = 0.9625),与直接国家级负二项广义可加模型(wMAPE = 14.85%)、一周期持续预测(15.65%)和直接国家级LightGBM(18.67%)相比。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于区级信息的自下而上预测实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差,同时保留了次国家级预测信息,但其相对于强比较对象的优势仍存在统计不确定性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,在进行国家级聚合之前保留区级信息可能为登革热住院病例的短期预测提供额外价值,这可能有助于制定更具针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的设计局限性包括:在初步2025年结果已知后,模型规格在同行评审过程中进行了修订;主要的国家级wMAPE差异的95%圆块自举置信区间均跨越了零点,表明存在统计不确定性。

abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热对孟加拉国的监测和医院服务造成持续压力,但大多数以孟加拉国为中心的预测研究都使用了国家级或时间聚合的数据。在进行国家级聚合之前保留区级信息是否能为短期预测提供额外价值仍不确定。本研究评估了基于区级信息和直接国家级方法在孟加拉国所有64个区的一周期前登革热住院病例预测。2022-2025年的全国监测-气象学面板包含93,504个区级日观测数据,汇总为13,312个完整的区级周记录。病例报告按报告区组织,而非患者居住地。一个单一的区级周数据池Light Gradient Boosting Machine(LightGBM)生成了区级特定的预测,并将这些预测汇总以获得国家级预测。该自下而上的方法与直接国家级LightGBM、负二项广义可加模型、一周期持续预测以及分层预测基准进行了比较。模型开发按时间顺序进行:2024年用于验证和模型选择,最终的模型规格使用所有2025年前的模型可用数据重新拟合,模型在整个2025年52周的评估期间保持不变。由于在初步2025年结果已知后,模型规格在同行评审过程中进行了修订,因此2025年未被纳入模型拟合,但不被视为完全未受干扰的测试集。自下而上的LightGBM在2025年实现了最低的国家级点误差(MAE = 239.37;RMSE = 380.27;wMAPE = 12.10%;R2 = 0.9625),与直接国家级负二项广义可加模型(wMAPE = 14.85%)、一周期持续预测(15.65%)和直接国家级LightGBM(18.67%)相比。在区级周层面,与持续预测相比的改进较为有限(wMAPE = 28.34% vs. 15.65%)。三个主要的全国wMAPE差异的95%圆块自举置信区间均跨越了零点,调整后的预测准确性测试未能确立统计上的优势。分层协调并未将国家级点误差降低到未协调的自下而上预测之下。SHapley Additive exPlanations(SHAP)识别出近期病例是主要的预测信号,而进一步分析表明,预测误差的大小在地理上存在异质性。基于残差的实证95%不确定性区间覆盖了52个未被使用的周中的49个(94.23%)。基于区级信息的自下而上预测实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差,同时保留了次国家级预测信息,但其相对于强比较对象的优势仍存在统计不确定性。在常规早期预警使用之前,需要进行前瞻性多季节验证。

title: A study of the global properties and optimal control of dengue disease transmission model
abstract: In this work, we formulate a nonlinear system of differential equations that models the transmission dynamics of dengue fever. The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.

The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及建立一个数学模型以模拟登革热传播动力学。该研究在理论环境中进行,使用微分方程,专注于登革热及其相关因素,而没有具体参考现实世界的人群或数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型通过非线性微分方程系统进行构建,利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉塞尔不变性原理分析平衡点的稳定性。研究还包括构建一个最优控制问题以评估登革热的预防措施和干预手段。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型展示了经典的阈值行为,当基本再生数小于1时,无病平衡点在局部和全局上都是渐近稳定的。当基本再生数超过1时,在某些条件下,地方性平衡点在全局上是渐近稳定的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为模型能够基于基本再生数预测登革热动力学的证据。其新颖之处在于将最优控制理论应用于评估登革热传播的干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为登革热监测的数学模型开发以及评估控制策略(如疫苗接种和杀虫剂治疗)提供信息。它们为理解疾病传播和干预措施的有效性提供了理论基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论建模,未包含实证数据或现实世界验证。证据来源于数学分析和模拟,可能无法完全反映登革热传播在真实人群中的复杂性。由于证据仅基于摘要,结果的可信度中等。

title: Dengue among febrile patients in Ghana: prevalence and facility-level variation in a multisite surveillance study
abstract: Introduction: Dengue is under-recognized in Ghana, where laboratory testing is limited. We estimated dengue NS1 and/or IgM positivity among febrile patients and described geographical, temporal, and demographic variation. Methodology: We conducted cross-sectional surveillance among consenting febrile patients aged [≥]1 year at six public facilities in Greater Accra, Bono East, and Upper West between August 2023 and July 2025. We randomly selected one region within each of three ecological strata and selected facilities with high febrile-case volumes. We approached and recruited consecutive eligible patients. We tested serum for dengue NS1 antigen and IgM antibody by ELISA; positive NS1 samples underwent RT-PCR and serotyping. We estimated proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CI) and used logistic regression to examine adjusted associations. Results: Among 2,936 participants, 204 were NS1- and/or IgM-positive (6.95%; 95% CI, 6.05-7.93%): 31 were NS1-only, 161 IgM-only, and 12 dual-positive. Prevalence ranged from 3.88% (95% CI, 2.19-6.31%) at Kintampo to 12.32% (9.56-15.55%) at Atebubu, both in Bono East. Adjusted odds increased with age (aOR per five years, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.05-1.14). Eight of 43 NS1-positive samples contained dengue RNA: five DENV-1 from Bono East and three DENV-3 from Upper West. There was no clear rainy-dry season difference. Conclusions: Dengue NS1 and/or IgM were detected among febrile patients at all six facilities, and RT-PCR confirmed circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-3. These findings support including dengue in febrile illness evaluation and strengthening laboratory-supported surveillance in Ghana. Keywords: dengue, febrile illness, NS1 antigen, IgM, DENV-1, DENV-3, Ghana
authors: Marianne A. B. van der Sande
van der Sande, M. A. B.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to estimate dengue NS1 and/or IgM positivity among febrile patients in Ghana and describe geographical, temporal, and demographic variation. A cross-sectional surveillance was conducted at six public facilities in Greater Accra, Bono East, and Upper West between August 2023 and July 2025, involving 2,936 participants. Serum samples were tested for dengue NS1 antigen and IgM antibody using ELISA, with positive NS1 samples further analyzed by RT-PCR and serotyping. The results showed that 204 participants (6.95%) were NS1- and/or IgM-positive, with prevalence varying across sites. RT-PCR confirmed the circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-3. The findings highlight the need to include dengue in febrile illness evaluation and enhance laboratory-supported surveillance in Ghana. The study's limitations are not explicitly reported in the supplied evidence.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在所有六家医疗机构的发热患者中均检测到登革热NS1和/或IgM阳性,RT-PCR证实了DENV-1和DENV-3的流行。

title: Epidemiología del dengue en Santo Domingo 2021-2025
abstract: Objetivo: Analizar el comportamiento temporal de las notificaciones de dengue en la provincia de Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas durante 2021–2025, a fin de identificar sus variaciones semanales y anuales. Metodología: Se realizó un estudio observacional, descriptivo y retrospectivo, con diseño ecológico de serie temporal, basado en registros epidemiológicos agregados. Los datos se organizaron por año y semana epidemiológica en Microsoft Excel y se procesaron mediante IBM SPSS Statistics, versión 27, utilizando estadística descriptiva. Además, las semanas se agruparon en cuatro bloques operativos: SE 1–13, SE 14–26, SE 27–39 y SE 40–53. Resultados: Se analizaron 15.744 notificaciones de dengue. En 2023 se observó la mayor concentración semanal, principalmente entre las semanas epidemiológicas 28 y 46; en 2024, las frecuencias más elevadas se registraron durante la primera mitad del año. La distribución anual mostró que 2023 concentró 6.312 notificaciones (40,09 %) y 2024, 5.890 (37,41 %), que representaron conjuntamente el 77,50 % del total. En 2025 se registraron 1.385 notificaciones, cifra que representó una reducción del 76,49 % respecto de 2024. Conclusiones: Las notificaciones presentaron variaciones temporales importantes, con una mayor concentración en 2023 y 2024. Los hallazgos aportaron una referencia descriptiva para el seguimiento epidemiológico provincial y la planificación de acciones de vigilancia y prevención. Se recomendó incorporar variables climáticas, entomológicas, virológicas y socioambientales en futuras investigaciones.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyze the temporal behavior of dengue notifications in the province of Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas from 2021 to 2025 to identify weekly and annual variations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, descriptive, and observational ecological time series study was conducted based on aggregated epidemiological records.
analysis.methods: Data were organized by year and epidemiological week in Microsoft Excel and processed using IBM SPSS Statistics, version 27, with descriptive statistics.
analysis.main_results: A total of 15,744 dengue notifications were analyzed. The highest weekly concentration was observed in 2023, mainly between epidemiological weeks 28 and 46; in 2024, the highest frequencies were recorded during the first half of the year. The annual distribution showed that 2023 had 6,312 notifications (40.09%) and 2024, 5,890 (37.41%), which together represented 77.50% of the total. In 2025, 1,385 notifications were recorded, a 76.49% reduction from 2024.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provided a descriptive reference for provincial epidemiological monitoring and the planning of surveillance and prevention actions. It was recommended to incorporate climatic, entomological, virological, and socio-environmental variables in future research.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study's findings can inform the surveillance and planning of actions for dengue prevention and control in the province.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the retrospective nature and the reliance on aggregated data, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed dengue notifications in Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas from 2021 to 2025, identifying weekly and annual variations. The highest concentrations were observed in 2023 and 2024, with a significant reduction in 2025. The findings provide a reference for surveillance and prevention.

title: Foundation models capture human and environmental context to improve dengue forecasting
abstract: Accurate and timely probabilistic dengue forecasts can support public health preparedness, but producing reliable forecasts across locations and time horizons remains challenging. We evaluated five statistical, machine-learning, deep-learning, and foundation-model approaches for forecasting monthly reported dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities at 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month horizons, with forecasts backtested from January 2020 to August 2025. The time-series foundation model TimesFM maintained comparatively stable probabilistic forecast performance at longer horizons, while most other models showed declining performance. We then tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations, although the magnitude and frequency of improvements varied across models, horizons and municipalities. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, including a reduction in mean WIS of 1.13 at the six-month horizon (95% CI [0.84, 1.48]; Diebold-Mariano p < 0.0001), with improvements also observed for XGBoost. The proportion of forecasts improved by PDFM generally increased with locally reported dengue case counts, although this relationship varied between models. Covariate selection, spatial fitting and forecast aggregation strategies showed strong model-dependent effects, while monthly model retraining provided no consistent advantage in the settings evaluated. Together, these findings highlight the potential of pretrained representations for dengue forecasting, with benefits dependent on forecasting architecture, horizon and modelling configuration.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of various forecasting models, including foundation models, in predicting monthly dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities. The research highlighted the challenges of producing reliable forecasts across different time horizons and locations. The time-series foundation model TimesFM showed stable performance at longer horizons, while most other models declined. The study tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, with a mean WIS reduction of 1.13 at the six-month horizon. The findings suggest that pretrained representations can enhance dengue forecasting, with benefits depending on the forecasting architecture, horizon, and modeling configuration. However, the study noted that covariate selection, spatial fitting, and forecast aggregation strategies had strong model-dependent effects, and monthly model retraining did not consistently improve outcomes. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study's focus on model performance and the absence of direct biological or clinical data on dengue virus.

title_zh: 基础模型捕捉人类和环境背景以提高登革热预测能力
source_body_en: Accurate and timely probabilistic dengue forecasts can support public health preparedness, but producing reliable forecasts across locations and time horizons remains challenging. We evaluated five statistical, machine-learning, deep-learning, and foundation-model approaches for forecasting monthly reported dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities at 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month horizons, with forecasts backtested from January 2020 to August 2025. The time-series foundation model TimesFM maintained comparatively stable probabilistic forecast performance at longer horizons, while most other models showed declining performance. We then tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations, although the magnitude and frequency of improvements varied across models, horizons and municipalities. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, including a reduction in mean WIS of 1.13 at the six-month horizon (95% CI [0.84, 1.48]; Diebold-Mariano p < 0.0001), with improvements also observed for XGBoost. The proportion of forecasts improved by PDFM generally increased with locally reported dengue case counts, although this relationship varied between models. Covariate selection, spatial fitting and forecast aggregation strategies showed strong model-dependent effects, while monthly model retraining provided no consistent advantage in the settings evaluated. Together, these findings highlight the potential of pretrained representations for dengue forecasting, with benefits dependent on forecasting architecture, horizon and modelling configuration.

title: DISTRIBUIÇÃO ESPACIAL E TEMPORAL DA DENGUE EM CRIANÇAS E ADOLESCENTES EM SANTA CATARINA (2021–2025): SUBSÍDIOS PARA AÇÕES DE EDUCAÇÃO EM SAÚDE NO AMBIENTE ESCOLAR
abstract: O ano de 2024 marcou a maior epidemia de dengue já registrada no país, com repercussão expressiva em Santa Catarina. Objetivo: analisar a distribuição espacial e temporal dos casos prováveis de dengue em crianças e adolescentes residentes em Santa Catarina, de 2021 a 2025. Método: estudo descritivo, quantitativo e retrospectivo, com dados secundários e agregados por município, obtidos junto ao CIEGES-SC, referentes à faixa etária escolar (5-19 anos), e dados populacionais do IBGE (Censo 2022). Calculou-se a incidência em relação ao total de casos no Estado, por faixa etária e por macrorregião de saúde. Resultados: foram registrados 109.918 (19,0%) casos na faixa etária de 5 a 19 anos. analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the spatial and temporal distribution of dengue cases in children and adolescents in Santa Catarina, Brazil, from 2021 to 2025. It aimed to provide insights for health education strategies in schools. The research used secondary data from CIEGES-SC and IBGE's 2022 census, aggregating cases by municipality and age group. Results showed that 19.0% of dengue cases occurred in children and adolescents, with 2024 being the peak year and the highest incidence rate of 4,396.9 cases per 100,000 inhabitants. The age groups 5-9 years and 15-17 years were most affected, and the Planalto Norte, Nordeste, and Vale do Itajaí macroregions had the highest case concentrations. The authors concluded that the heterogeneity in dengue distribution among children and adolescents highlights the need for targeted health education in schools. The study's findings are based on aggregated data, which may limit their precision and generalizability, but they provide valuable insights for public health interventions.

title: Evolutionarily distinct dengue virus type 2 with a unique type-specific neutralization determinant
abstract: Dengue viruses 1-4 (DENV1-4) mostly circulate in endemic cycles involving humans and Aedes mosquitoes. However, rare dengue outbreaks originate from non-human primates. These spillovers are caused by sylvatic virus genotypes that are closely related to endemic strains of the same serotype, but some are caused by strains that fall between the four canonical serotypes on phylogenetic trees. It is not clear whether these genotypic differences are reflected in corresponding antigenic differences. Here, we characterized the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent strain most closely related to DENV2. On an antigenic map, QML-22 clustered with other globally representative DENV2 strains. QML-22 was not as well neutralized by antisera raised against endemic DENV2 and was better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections than other strains of DENV2. QML-22 had a cluster of distinct amino acid residues in domain I of the envelope (E) protein, with only scattered point mutations elsewhere in the envelope. A potently neutralizing anti-DENV2 antibody that targets this site in domain I of the E protein, 3F9, had >1000-fold lower neutralization of QML-22 than other endemic DENV2 strains, whereas other cross-reactive and DENV2-specific antibodies neutralized QML-22 and endemic strains to similar titers. When antisera from non-human primates infected with QML-22 or DENV2 reference strain S16803 were depleted with the heterologous virions, homologous neutralization was unaffected but heterologous neutralization was reduced, suggesting homologous neutralization was due to distinct epitopes. Evolutionary analyses showed the 3F9 epitope was under relaxed selection pressure compared to other neutralizing epitopes and that QML-22 had unique amino acids in this epitope relative to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2. These findings provide insight into the antigenic diversification of DENV and the possible evolution of new serotypes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether genotypic differences in dengue virus type 2 (DENV2) strains, such as QML-22, are associated with antigenic differences. This is important because understanding antigenic variation can inform vaccine development and surveillance strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent DENV2 strain, using antisera from infections with other DENV serotypes and non-human primates. The research focused on DENV2 and its relationship to other DENV serotypes.
analysis.methods: Antisera from non-human primates infected with QML-22 or DENV2 reference strain S16803 were used to assess neutralization. The 3F9 antibody, which targets a specific epitope in the envelope protein, was tested for its neutralization capacity against QML-22 and other DENV2 strains. Evolutionary analyses were conducted to compare the epitope's sequence across strains.
analysis.main_results: QML-22 was not as well neutralized by antisera against endemic DENV2 strains but was better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections. The 3F9 epitope in QML-22 showed unique amino acids compared to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2 strains.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the antigenic differences in QML-22 are significant and may contribute to its distinct neutralization profile. This highlights the antigenic diversification of DENV2 and raises the possibility of new serotypes evolving.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the antigenic evolution of DENV2, which could inform the development of more effective vaccines and improve surveillance strategies for emerging strains.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by direct experimental results and evolutionary comparisons, providing a moderate level of confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent dengue virus type 2 (DENV2) strain, and finds that it is not as well neutralized by antisera against endemic DENV2 strains but is better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections. The 3F9 epitope in QML-22 shows unique amino acids compared to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2 strains. These findings suggest antigenic diversification within DENV2 and raise the possibility of new serotypes evolving. The study provides insights into the evolution of DENV2, which could inform vaccine development and surveillance strategies. However, the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may limit the depth of analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨登革病毒型2(DENV2)株系,如QML-22,的基因型差异是否与抗原差异相关。这是重要的,因为了解抗原变异可以为抗病毒药物开发和疫苗接种策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用非人类灵长类动物感染产生的抗血清来表征QML-22的抗原特征。研究重点是DENV2及其与其他DENV血清型的关系。
elements_zh.methods: 使用非人类灵长类动物感染QML-22或DENV2参考株S16803所产生的抗血清来评估中和能力。测试了针对包膜蛋白域I特定表位的3F9抗体对QML-22和其他DENV2株系的中和能力。进行了进化分析,比较不同株系中该表位的序列。
elements_zh.main_results: QML-22并未被针对地方性DENV2毒株的抗血清有效中和,但被DENV1、3和4感染产生的抗血清更好地中和。QML-22中的3F9表位与所有DENV2毒株的可能共同祖先相比显示出独特的氨基酸。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明QML-22的抗原差异具有显著性,并可能与其独特的中和表型有关。这突显了DENV2的抗原多样化,并提出了新血清型进化的可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为DENV2的抗原变异提供了见解,这可能有助于开发更有效的抗病毒药物,并改进针对新兴株系的疫苗接种策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于摘要证据,这可能限制分析的深度。然而,研究结果得到了直接实验数据和进化比较的支持,提供了中等程度的置信度。

abstract_zh: 登革病毒 1-4(DENV1-4)主要在人类和Aedes蚊虫的流行循环中传播。然而,罕见的登革热暴发来源于非人类灵长类动物。这些跨物种溢出是由森林病毒基因型引起的,这些基因型与同型的流行株密切相关,但有些是由在系统发育树上位于四个经典型之间的株系引起的。尚不清楚这些基因型差异是否反映在相应的抗原差异上。在这里,我们表征了QML-22的抗原特征,QML-22是一种与DENV2最接近的变异株。在抗原图谱上,QML-22与其他全球代表性DENV2株系聚类在一起。QML-22对针对流行DENV2的抗血清中和能力不如其他DENV2株系,但对DENV1、DENV3和DENV4感染产生的抗血清中和能力优于其他DENV2株系。QML-22在包膜(E)蛋白的域I中有一簇独特的氨基酸残基,而在E蛋白的其他区域仅有零星的点突变。一种针对E蛋白域I特定表位的强效中和抗DENV2抗体3F9,对QML-22的中和能力比其他流行DENV2株系低1000倍以上,而其他交叉反应性和DENV2特异性抗体对QML-22和流行株的中和能力相似。当用非人类灵长类动物感染QML-22或DENV2参考株S16803的抗血清去除异源病毒颗粒后,同源中和能力未受影响,但异源中和能力降低,这表明同源中和是由不同的表位引起的。进化分析显示,3F9表位相较于其他中和表位处于较弱的正选择压力下,并且QML-22在该表位上具有与所有DENV2可能共同祖先不同的独特氨基酸。这些发现为登革病毒(DENV)的抗原多样化提供了见解,并提出了新血清型出现的可能性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨登革病毒型2(DENV2)株系,如QML-22,的基因型差异是否与抗原差异相关。这是重要的,因为了解抗原变异可以为抗病毒药物开发和疫苗接种策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用非人类灵长类动物感染产生的抗血清来表征QML-22的抗原特征。研究重点是DENV2及其与其他DENV血清型的关系。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用非人类灵长类动物感染QML-22或DENV2参考株S16803所产生的抗血清来评估中和能力。测试了针对包膜蛋白域I特定表位的3F9抗体对QML-22和其他DENV2株系的中和能力。进行了进化分析,比较不同株系中该表位的序列。
analysis_zh.main_results: QML-22并未被针对地方性DENV2毒株的抗血清有效中和,但被DENV1、3和4感染产生的抗血清更好地中和。QML-22中的3F9表位与所有DENV2毒株的可能共同祖先相比显示出独特的氨基酸。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明QML-22的抗原差异具有显著性,并可能与其独特的中和表型有关。这突显了DENV2的抗原多样化,并提出了新血清型进化的可能性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为DENV2的抗原变异提供了见解,这可能有助于开发更有效的抗病毒药物,并改进针对新兴株系的疫苗接种策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于摘要证据,这可能限制分析的深度。然而,研究结果得到了直接实验数据和进化比较的支持,提供了中等程度的置信度。

title: Tetravalent dengue mRNA vaccination orchestrates balanced four-serotype immunity with durable memory and protection in mice.
abstract: An effective dengue vaccine must establish durable immunity across four dengue virus (DENV) serotypes, evade antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), and overcome immune imprinting from prior exposure. Here, we developed TetprM-E mRNA-LNP, a tetravalent vaccine comprising LNP-formulated nucleoside-modified mRNAs encoding DENV1-4 precursor membrane-envelope (prM-E) antigens, and evaluated its immunogenicity, durability, protection and breath across serotype-specific immune backgrounds. Three immunization strategies elicited neutralizing titers greater than 1:1500 against each serotype. Passive transfer of immune sera conferred 100% survival and reduced viremia after lethal DENV2 challenge in immunocompromised mice. Vaccination induced DENV envelope (env)-specific CD8+T cells and CD4-dependent germinal-center responses. DENV env-binding antibodies persisted for 34 weeks alongside DENV env-specific memory B cells. Vaccine-elicited sera showed no measurable in vitro ADE. Although monovalent priming initially biased antibody responses, TetprM-E mRNA-LNP vaccination broadened neutralization across DENV1-4 regardless of priming serotype. Together, TetprM-E mRNA-LNP elicits broad, durable, and protective immunity despite serologic constraints from pre-existing immunity.

abstract_zh: 一种有效的登革病毒疫苗必须在四种登革病毒(DENV)血清型中建立持久的免疫力,避免抗体依赖性增强(ADE),并克服先前暴露引起的免疫印记。在这里,我们开发了TetprM-E mRNA-LNP,一种包含针对DENV1-4的前膜-包膜(prM-E)抗原的四价疫苗,其通过脂质纳米颗粒(LNP)递送的核苷修饰mRNA进行制备,并评估了其在特定血清型免疫背景下的免疫原性、持久性、保护性和广谱性。三种免疫策略均诱导了针对每种血清型的中和抗体滴度大于1:1500。将免疫血清被动转移至免疫缺陷小鼠后,可实现100%存活率,并在致命性DENV2感染后降低病毒血症。疫苗接种诱导了针对登革病毒包膜(env)的CD8+T细胞和依赖CD4的生发中心反应。登革病毒env结合抗体与env特异性记忆B细胞在34周内持续存在。由疫苗诱导的血清在体外未检测到可测量的ADE。尽管单价免疫最初偏向抗体应答,但TetprM-E mRNA-LNP 疫苗接种无论先前免疫血清型如何,均能广谱中和DENV1-4。综上所述,TetprM-E mRNA-LNP能够在存在先前免疫血清学限制的情况下,诱导广泛、持久且具有保护性的免疫力。

title: MicroRNA-based point-of-care diagnostics for emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases: from biomarker discovery to clinical implementation.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are increasingly investigated as host-response biomarkers for infectious diseases, but translation from differential-expression studies to clinically deployable diagnostics remains limited. AREAS COVERED: This review evaluates the diagnostic and translational potential of miRNAs across malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika virus infection, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, Japanese encephalitis and Nipah virus disease. Unlike prior reviews focused mainly on biomarker discovery or detection technologies, it provides a cross-disease translational perspective linking miRNA signatures with analytical and clinical validation, point-of-care development, clinical implementation, economic considerations and deployment in resource-limited settings. EXPERT OPINION: The next phase of miRNA diagnostics should prioritize reproducible multi-miRNA signatures, standardized pre-analytical workflows and prospective multicentre validation rather than continued biomarker discovery alone. Clinical adoption will depend on integrating these signatures into affordable sample-to-answer platforms and demonstrating that results improve defined clinical decisions under real-world conditions.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the use of microRNA-based point-of-care diagnostics for dengue virus and dengue disease, including severe dengue, dengue hemorrhagic fever, dengue shock syndrome, dengue fever, and dengue virus 1–4. The central question is how miRNA signatures can be translated into clinically deployable diagnostics for these conditions.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review evaluates the diagnostic and translational potential of miRNAs across dengue virus and related diseases. It provides a cross-disease translational perspective, linking miRNA signatures with analytical and clinical validation, point-of-care development, clinical implementation, economic considerations, and deployment in resource-limited settings. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that miRNA-based diagnostics have potential for clinical implementation in dengue disease, particularly when integrated into affordable sample-to-answer platforms. It emphasizes the need for reproducible multi-miRNA signatures and standardized pre-analytical workflows to improve clinical utility.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is a lack of standardized pre-analytical workflows and prospective multicentre validation for miRNA-based diagnostics in dengue. The review also notes that continued biomarker discovery alone is insufficient for clinical deployment, and real-world conditions must be considered to demonstrate improved clinical decisions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize the development of reproducible multi-miRNA signatures, standardized pre-analytical workflows, and prospective multicentre validation for miRNA-based diagnostics in dengue. These efforts are critical for translating miRNA research into practical, affordable point-of-care solutions.

The review highlights that while miRNA research is promising, there are gaps in standardization and multicentre validation. The review also notes that continued biomarker discovery alone is not sufficient for clinical deployment.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于基于微小RNA的现场快速诊断方法在登革热和相关疾病中的应用,包括登革热轻症、登革热出血热、登革热休克综合征、登革热重症以及登革热1–4型。核心问题是:如何将miRNA特征转化为这些疾病的可临床部署诊断方法。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述评估了miRNA在登革热及相关疾病中的诊断和转化潜力。它提供了一个跨疾病转化视角,将miRNA特征与分析和临床验证、现场快速诊断开发、临床应用、经济考量以及资源有限地区的部署联系起来。综述中并未明确报告元分析或汇总估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述强调,基于miRNA的诊断方法在登革热疾病中具有临床应用的潜力,特别是在整合到经济实惠的样本到答案平台后。它指出需要可重复的多miRNA特征和标准化的预分析流程以提高临床实用性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 目前缺乏基于miRNA的登革热诊断方法的标准化预分析流程和前瞻性多中心验证。综述还指出,仅继续发现生物标志物不足以实现临床部署,必须考虑真实世界条件以证明其对临床决策的改善。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先发展基于miRNA的登革热诊断方法的可重复多miRNA特征、标准化预分析流程以及前瞻性多中心验证。这些努力对于将miRNA研究转化为实际、经济的现场快速诊断解决方案至关重要。

abstract_zh: 引言:微小RNA(miRNA)作为感染性疾病的免疫应答生物标志物正受到越来越多的关注,但将差异表达研究转化为可临床部署的诊断方法仍存在局限。研究领域:本综述评估了miRNA在疟疾、登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒感染、克里米亚-刚果出血热、日本脑炎和尼帕病毒感染等疾病中的诊断和转化潜力。与以往主要关注生物标志物发现或检测技术的综述不同,本综述提供了一个跨疾病转化视角,将miRNA特征与分析和临床验证、现场快速诊断开发、临床应用、经济考量以及资源有限地区的部署联系起来。专家观点:miRNA诊断的下一步应优先考虑可重复的多miRNA特征、标准化的预分析流程以及前瞻性多中心验证,而不是仅仅继续进行生物标志物的发现。临床采用将取决于将这些特征整合到经济实惠的样本到答案平台中,并在真实世界条件下证明其结果能够改善特定的临床决策。

title: Etiological spectrum of acute encephalitis syndrome in children in India: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) continues to be an important cause of illness and death among children in India. While Japanese encephalitis (JE) virus has traditionally been regarded as the leading cause, recent studies indicate that the range of causative organisms has widened considerably. AIM: To estimate the pooled proportion of AES cases attributable to various common infectious etiologies among children aged 18 years or younger in India. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Scopus was conducted for studies published between January 2000 and December 2025. Studies conducted in India that included at least 25 children (≤ 18 years) with AES and reported laboratory-confirmed etiologies were considered eligible. Case reports and small case series were excluded. Quality assessment of included studies was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. A random-effects model was used to obtain pooled estimates and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). RESULTS: A total of 69 studies were included in the final analysis. Scrub typhus emerged as the most common cause, accounting for 20% (95%CI: 13%-27%) of AES cases, followed by JE at 13% (95%CI: 11%-15%). Enterovirus accounted for 6% of the cases (95%CI: 3%-9%). Dengue, herpes simplex virus and Epstein-Barr virus accounted for 5% of the cases each (95%CI: 3%-8%, 2%-9%, and 1%-11%, respectively). Mumps and chikungunya virus accounted for 4% each (95%CI: 1%-8%, and 2%-5%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Scrub typhus and JE are the leading identifiable etiology of pediatric AES in India. Broader diagnostic methods, including molecular techniques, may improve the diagnostic yield and facilitate early targeted therapy in children with AES.

abstract_zh: 背景:急性脑炎综合征(AES)仍然是印度儿童疾病和死亡的重要原因。尽管日本脑炎(JE)病毒传统上被认为是主要病因,但近期研究表明,导致AES的病原体范围已显著扩大。目的:估计印度18岁以下儿童中各种常见感染性病因导致的AES病例的汇总比例。方法:在PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE和Scopus上进行了全面的文献检索,筛选了2000年1月至2025年12月期间发表的研究。纳入标准为在印度进行的、包含至少25名(≤18岁)AES患儿并报告实验室确诊病因的研究。病例报告和小型病例系列被排除。使用Joanna Briggs研究所清单对纳入研究进行质量评估。采用随机效应模型计算汇总估计值及其对应的95%置信区间(CI)。结果:最终分析共纳入69项研究。scrub typhus(恙虫病)成为最常见的病因,占AES病例的20%(95%CI:13%-27%),其次是JE病毒占13%(95%CI:11%-15%)。肠道病毒占6%(95%CI:3%-9%)。登革病毒、单纯疱疹病毒和EB病毒各占5%(95%CI:3%-8%、2%-9%和1%-11%)。腮腺炎病毒和基孔肯雅病毒各占4%(95%CI:1%-8%和2%-5%)。结论: scrub typhus和JE病毒是印度儿童AES的主要可识别病因。更广泛的诊断方法,包括分子技术,可能提高诊断效率,并有助于对AES患儿进行早期针对性治疗。

title: Immature Platelet Fraction in Viral Infections: A Systematic Review of Current Applications and Future Perspectives
abstract: Background: Reticulated platelets, reported by modern hematology analyzers as the immature platelet fraction (IPF%) or the absolute immature platelet count (IPC), index thrombopoiesis and have been proposed as biomarkers in the thrombocytopenia of viral infection. Methods: This systematic review, conducted and reported following PRISMA 2020 and registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261501412), examined how these parameters have been used across viral diseases. PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched from January 2000 to May 2025 for observational studies of adults with viral infection reporting IPF, IPC, or reticulated platelets, and methodological robustness was appraised with the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale. Results: Twenty-two studies were included and synthesized narratively. Applications differed by pathogen: in dengue, serial IPF increases consistently preceded platelet recovery, although proposed thresholds varied; in COVID-19, higher immature platelet parameters were associated with severity and mortality but were inconsistent after adjustment. Evidence in chronic hepatitis, HIV, hantavirus, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever was mainly pathophysiological, and data in critically ill patients were almost confined to COVID-19. Conclusions: Clinical value appears disease- and outcome-specific: serial IPF best predicts platelet recovery in dengue, whereas prognostic use in COVID-19 remains insufficiently validated. Analytical heterogeneity and the absence of transferable thresholds currently limit clinical implementation.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on dengue virus and its associated disease, specifically examining the role of the immature platelet fraction (IPF%) and absolute immature platelet count (IPC) as biomarkers in thrombocytopenia during viral infections. The central question is how these parameters are used across different dengue-related conditions and their clinical relevance.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review was conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261501412). It searched PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library from January 2000 to May 2025 for observational studies of adults with viral infections, specifically those reporting IPF, IPC, or reticulated platelets. Methodological robustness was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review synthesized 22 studies narratively. It found that in dengue, serial increases in IPF consistently preceded platelet recovery, although proposed thresholds varied. In contrast, higher immature platelet parameters in COVID-19 were associated with severity and mortality but were inconsistent after adjustment. The clinical value of these parameters appears to be disease- and outcome-specific.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Analytical heterogeneity and the absence of transferable thresholds currently limit the clinical implementation of IPF and IPC as biomarkers. Evidence in chronic hepatitis, HIV, hantavirus, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever was mainly pathophysiological, and data in critically ill patients were almost confined to COVID-19.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to establish consistent thresholds for IPF and IPC across different viral infections, particularly for dengue. There is a need for more robust studies to validate the prognostic use of these parameters in dengue and other related conditions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review explores the use of immature platelet fraction (IPF%) and absolute immature platelet count (IPC) as biomarkers in thrombocytopenia associated with dengue virus infections. The review, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, analyzed 22 observational studies from 2000 to 2025, focusing on adults with dengue-related conditions. It found that in dengue, serial IPF increases consistently preceded platelet recovery, though thresholds varied. In contrast, higher immature platelet parameters in COVID-19 were linked to severity and mortality but were inconsistent after adjustment. The clinical utility of these parameters appears to be disease-specific, with limited transferability across conditions. The review highlights the need for further research to standardize thresholds and validate their prognostic value in dengue and related viral infections.

title_zh: 病毒性感染中未成熟血小板分数:当前应用与未来展望的系统综述
source_body_en: Background: Reticulated platelets, reported by modern hematology analyzers as the immature platelet fraction (IPF%) or the absolute immature platelet count (IPC), index thrombopoiesis and have been proposed as biomarkers in the thrombocytopenia of viral infection. Methods: This systematic review, conducted and reported following PRISMA 2020 and registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261501412), examined how these parameters have been used across viral diseases. PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched from January 2000 to May 2025 for observational studies of adults with viral infection reporting IPF, IPC, or reticulated platelets, and methodological robustness was appraised with the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale. Results: Twenty-two studies were included and synthesized narratively. Applications differed by pathogen: in dengue, serial IPF increases consistently preceded platelet recovery, although proposed thresholds varied; in COVID-19, higher immature platelet parameters were associated with severity and mortality but were inconsistent after adjustment. Evidence in chronic hepatitis, HIV, hantavirus, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever was mainly pathophysiological, and data in critically ill patients were almost confined to COVID-19. Conclusions: Clinical value appears disease- and outcome-specific: serial IPF best predicts platelet recovery in dengue, whereas prognostic use in COVID-19 remains insufficiently validated. Analytical heterogeneity and the absence of transferable thresholds currently limit clinical implementation.
abstract_zh: 背景:现代血液分析仪将网织血小板报告为未成熟血小板分数(IPF%)或绝对未成熟血小板计数(IPC),这些参数可作为血小板生成的指标,并被提出作为病毒性感染血小板减少症的生物标志物。方法:本系统综述遵循PRISMA 2020指南进行,并在PROSPERO(CRD420261501412)注册。通过检索PubMed、Scopus和Cochrane Library(时间范围为2000年1月至2025年5月),评估了这些参数在不同病毒性疾病中的应用情况。对成人病毒性感染的观察性研究进行了系统分析,并采用Newcastle–Ottawa量表评估方法学的稳健性。结果:共纳入22项研究并进行叙述性综合。应用情况因病原体而异:在登革热中,连续IPF升高始终先于血小板恢复,尽管提出的阈值有所不同;在COVID-19中,较高的未成熟血小板参数与严重程度和死亡率相关,但在调整后结果不一致。慢性肝炎、HIV、汉坦病毒和克里米亚–刚果出血热的证据主要基于发病机制,而危重患者的数据几乎仅限于COVID-19。结论:临床价值似乎具有疾病和预后特异性:在登革热中,连续IPF最能预测血小板恢复,而在COVID-19中,其预后用途仍缺乏充分验证。分析的异质性和缺乏可转移的阈值目前限制了其临床应用。

title: Analysis of Cell Populations from Arbovirus-Infected Tissues by Flow Cytometry.
abstract: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. title: Near or Far?
abstract: Dengue fever is a growing public health threat in urban Bangladesh, yet the role of hospital proximity as a spatial determinant of case detection remains largely untested. This chapter examines whether residents living closer to a dengue-treating hospital are more likely to be detected as cases, using cross-sectional survey data from two Dhaka sites: Dhaka Community Medical College Hospital (Boro Moghbazar) and Mugdha Medical College Hospital. Detection declined significantly with distance, and the effect persisted after adjustment for awareness, age, and prior infection, with each additional 100 meters of distance lowering the odds of detection by roughly 5%. Having an affected neighbor was the strongest correlate of detection, indicating fine-scale spatial clustering. Healthcare-worker responses revealed high knowledge but lower preventive practice, suggesting an institutional engagement gap. A divergent pattern in one distant zone coincided with localized drainage construction, suggesting environmental disturbances can temporarily override the proximity effect.
journal: Mitigation Measures for Environmental and Humanitarian Disasters

title: Pemberdayaan Masyarakat dengan Gerakan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN) dan Survey Vektor DBD
abstract: This community service activity aimed to improve students’ knowledge and awareness of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) prevention through the Mosquito Nest Eradication Movement (PSN), vector surveys, epidemiological investigations, and early detection of DHF. The activity was conducted on August 29–30, 2026, at SMA Negeri 4 Manado, involving 60 students in collaboration with healthcare workers, Ranomut Community Health Center, the Manado City Health Office, and school representatives. The implementation methods included preparation, health education, vector surveys, follow-up actions, and evaluation. The educational materials covered the 3M Plus approach, identification of mosquito breeding sites, dengue transmission prevention, epidemiological investigations, and recognition of DHF symptoms and warning signs. The results showed that PSN education and vector surveys were conducted according to the planned topics. The survey found no mosquito larvae in potential breeding sites within the school environment, which was attributed to the dry season. This activity is expected to encourage students and school personnel to actively maintain environmental cleanliness and implement PSN measures sustainably.

abstract_zh: 本次社区服务活动旨在通过灭蚊运动(PSN)、媒介调查、流行病学调查和登革热出血热(DHF)的早期检测,提高学生对登革热出血热(DHF)预防的知识和意识。活动于2026年8月29日至30日在万隆第四国立中学(SMA Negeri 4 Manado)进行,涉及60名学生,与医疗工作者、拉诺穆特社区卫生中心(Ranomut Community Health Center)、万隆市卫生办公室(Manado City Health Office)及学校代表合作开展。实施方法包括准备阶段、健康教育、媒介调查、后续行动和评估。教育材料涵盖3M Plus方法、蚊虫孳生地识别、登革热传播预防、流行病学调查以及登革热出血热症状和警示信号的识别。结果显示,PSN教育和媒介调查均按照计划主题进行。调查发现学校环境中潜在孳生地内没有蚊虫幼虫,这归因于旱季。本次活动预计能够鼓励学生和学校工作人员积极维护环境卫生,并可持续实施PSN措施。

title: Pengaruh ekstrak rimpang temulawak (Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb) terhadap mortalitas larva Aedes albopictus
abstract: Background: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) is caused by the dengue virus (DENV), transmitted through of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. Larval control is essential to break transmission. One environmentally friendly alternative is natural larvicides. Temulawak rhizome (Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb) contains active compounds such as saponins, tanins, alkaloids, and flavonoids with potential as plant-based larvicides.Objectives: To evaluate the larvicidal effectiveness of Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb. rhizome extract against third-instar Aedes albopictus larvae.Methods: This study used a quantitative true experimental design with a post-test only control group. Samples were selected through purposive sampling. Temulawak rhizome extract was obtained through maceration using 96% ethanol. Larvae were tested at five concentrations (0.6%, 0.8%, 1.0%, 1.2%, and 1.5%) with observations at 3, 6, 12, and 24 hours. Data were analyzed using the Kruskal–Wallis test, Mann–Whitney post-hoc test, and probit analysis to determine LC50, LC90, LT50, and LT90. The preparation of Curcuma xanthorrhiza rhizome extract was conducted at the Biomedical Laboratory I, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Palangka Raya, while larvicidal testing was performed at the Public Health Laboratory Center, Tanah Bumbu, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, from July to October 2025.Results: Larval mortality increased with higher concentrations and longer exposure. The Kruskal–Wallis test showed significant differences among treatments (p < 0.05). LC50 was 0.614% and LC90 was 1.459%, while LT50 was 5.613 hours and LT90 was 15.102 hours. Active metabolites are presumed to contribute to larval mortality.Conclusion: Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb. rhizome extract demonstrated effective larvicidal activity against third-instar Aedes albopictus larvae, with efficacy increasing according to extract concentration and exposure time. These findings provide scientific evidence supporting the potential use of C. xanthorrhiza as an environmentally friendly plant-based larvicide and contribute to the development of sustainable alternative strategies for dengue vector control.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the larvicidal effectiveness of Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb extract against third-instar Aedes albopictus larvae. The research is motivated by the need for environmentally friendly alternatives to control dengue transmission, as Aedes albopictus is a key vector for dengue disease. The study employed a quantitative true experimental design with a post-test only control group, using purposive sampling. Temulawak rhizome extract was prepared via maceration with 96% ethanol and tested at five concentrations over specific exposure times. The results showed that larval mortality increased with higher concentrations and longer exposure, with significant differences among treatments (p < 0.05). The LC50 and LC90 values were 0.614% and 1.459%, respectively, while LT50 and LT90 were 5.613 hours and 15.102 hours. The findings suggest that the extract could be a viable, eco-friendly larvicide for dengue vector control. The study provides scientific evidence for the potential use of C. xanthorrhiza in this context, though no limitations are explicitly reported.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热出血热(DHF)是由登革病毒(DENV)引起的,通过埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊传播。控制幼虫是打破传播链的关键。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用定量真实实验设计,仅进行后测控制组。样本通过目的抽样法选取。姜黄根提取物的制备在帕朗卡拉大学医学院生物医学实验室I进行,而幼虫杀灭测试则在南加里曼丹省坦布布县公共卫生实验室中心进行,时间为2025年7月至10月。
elements_zh.methods: 姜黄根提取物通过96%乙醇浸渍法获得。幼虫在五个浓度(0.6%、0.8%、1.0%、1.2%和1.5%)下进行测试,观察时间为3、6、12和24小时。数据通过Kruskal–Wallis检验、Mann–Whitney事后检验和Probit分析进行分析,以确定LC50、LC90、LT50和LT90。
elements_zh.main_results: 幼虫死亡率随着浓度的增加和暴露时间的延长而增加。Kruskal–Wallis检验显示不同浓度之间存在显著差异(p < 0.05)。LC50为0.614%,LC90为1.459%,而LT50为5.613小时,LT90为15.102小时。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 姜黄根提取物对白纹伊蚊三龄幼虫表现出有效的幼虫杀灭活性,其效果随着提取物浓度和暴露时间的增加而增强。这些发现为姜黄根作为环保型植物源幼虫杀灭剂的潜在应用提供了科学依据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于开发可持续的登革热控制替代策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告局限性。研究设计为定量真实实验设计,仅进行后测控制组,结果基于对幼虫死亡率的统计分析。

abstract_zh: 背景:登革热出血热(DHF)是由登革病毒(DENV)引起的,通过埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊传播。控制幼虫是打破传播链的关键。一种环保的替代方法是天然幼虫杀灭剂。姜黄根(Curcuma xanthorrhiza Roxb)含有皂苷、单宁、生物碱和黄酮类等活性化合物,具有作为植物源幼虫杀灭剂的潜力。目的:评估姜黄根提取物对白纹伊蚊三龄幼虫的幼虫杀灭效果。方法:本研究采用定量真实实验设计,仅进行后测控制组。样本通过目的抽样法选取。姜黄根提取物通过96%乙醇浸渍法获得。幼虫在五个浓度(0.6%、0.8%、1.0%、1.2%和1.5%)下进行测试,观察时间为3、6、12和24小时。数据通过Kruskal–Wallis检验、Mann–Whitney事后检验和Probit分析进行分析,以确定LC50、LC90、LT50和LT90。姜黄根提取物的制备在帕朗卡拉大学医学院生物医学实验室I进行,而幼虫杀灭测试则在南加里曼丹省坦布布县公共卫生实验室中心进行,时间为2025年7月至10月。结果:幼虫死亡率随着浓度的增加和暴露时间的延长而增加。Kruskal–Wallis检验显示不同浓度之间存在显著差异(p < 0.05)。LC50为0.614%,LC90为1.459%,而LT50为5.613小时,LT90为15.102小时。活性代谢产物被认为对幼虫死亡率的增加有所贡献。结论:姜黄根提取物对白纹伊蚊三龄幼虫表现出有效的幼虫杀灭活性,其效果随着提取物浓度和暴露时间的增加而增强。这些发现为姜黄根作为环保型植物源幼虫杀灭剂的潜在应用提供了科学依据,并有助于开发可持续的登革热控制替代策略。
